      import { LIMITS } from "@agentica/protocol";
      
      export type Box = { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
      export type Rect = { left: number; top: number; right: number; bottom: number };
      export type Viewport = { x: number; y: number; zoom: number };
      export type Insets = {
        top: number;
        right: number;
        bottom: number;
        left: number;
      };
      
      /**
       * Starting layout budget for new conversation cards, in canvas units. The
       * runtime uses the same width and maximum height when it creates turn nodes.
       */
      export const CARD = { width: 340, height: 220, minHeight: 160, gap: 32 };
      
      /** Room reserved for a prompt, its reply, and a nearby proposal. */
      export const EXCHANGE_RESERVE = {
        width: 760,
        height: CARD.height * 2 + CARD.gap,
      };
      
      /** Dimensions applied by the explicit Compact conversation action. */
      export function compactSize(node: Pick<Box, "width" | "height">) {
        return {
          width: CARD.width,
          height: Math.min(Math.max(node.height, LIMITS.minSize), CARD.height),
        };
      }
      
      export type StatusTone = "neutral" | "busy" | "pending" | "ok" | "bad";
      
      /** Session counts shown on a project group, by state. */
      export type ProjectCounts = {
        running: number;
        starting: number;
        stopping: number;
        stopped: number;
        waiting: number;
      };
      
      /** Separate status items for a project group; zero counts are omitted. */
      export function projectStatusItems(
        counts: ProjectCounts,
      ): { label: string; tone: StatusTone }[] {
        const items: { label: string; tone: StatusTone }[] = [];
        if (counts.running)
          items.push({ label: `${counts.running} running`, tone: "ok" });
        if (counts.starting)
          items.push({ label: `${counts.starting} starting`, tone: "busy" });
        if (counts.stopping)
          items.push({ label: `${counts.stopping} stopping`, tone: "busy" });
        if (counts.stopped)
          items.push({ label: `${counts.stopped} stopped`, tone: "neutral" });
        if (counts.waiting)
          items.push({
            label: `${counts.waiting} waiting for you`,
            tone: "pending",
          });
        return items.length ? items : [{ label: "No sessions yet", tone: "neutral" }];
      }
      
      /** Readable header state derived from the persisted turn status. */
      export function turnStatus(
        status: string | undefined,
        role: "You" | "Agent",
      ): { label: string; tone: StatusTone } | undefined {
        if (!status) return undefined;
        if (role === "You") {
          if (status === "generating")
            return { label: "Waiting for reply", tone: "busy" };
          if (status === "failed") return { label: "Failed", tone: "bad" };
          if (status === "cancelled") return { label: "Cancelled", tone: "bad" };
          if (status === "interrupted") return { label: "Interrupted", tone: "bad" };
          return { label: "Sent", tone: "neutral" };
        }
        switch (status) {
          case "pending":
            return { label: "Changes pending review", tone: "pending" };
          case "applied":
            return { label: "Changes applied", tone: "ok" };
          case "discarded":
            return { label: "Changes discarded", tone: "neutral" };
          case "complete":
            return { label: "Complete", tone: "neutral" };
          case "generating":
            return { label: "Generating…", tone: "busy" };
          case "failed":
            return { label: "Failed", tone: "bad" };
          case "cancelled":
            return { label: "Cancelled", tone: "bad" };
          case "interrupted":
            return { label: "Interrupted", tone: "bad" };
          default:
            return { label: status, tone: "neutral" };
        }
      }
      
      /**
       * Insets of the canvas covered by overlays. Each obstacle (screen rect) is
       * charged to the edge where it removes the least usable area.
       */
      export function overlayInsets(canvas: Rect, obstacles: Rect[]): Insets {
        const insets: Insets = { top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0 };
        const width = canvas.right - canvas.left;
        const height = canvas.bottom - canvas.top;
        for (const item of obstacles) {
          const left = Math.max(item.left, canvas.left);
          const right = Math.min(item.right, canvas.right);
          const top = Math.max(item.top, canvas.top);
          const bottom = Math.min(item.bottom, canvas.bottom);
          if (right <= left || bottom <= top) continue;
          const candidates: [keyof Insets, number, number][] = [
            ["top", bottom - canvas.top, (bottom - canvas.top) * width],
            ["bottom", canvas.bottom - top, (canvas.bottom - top) * width],
            ["left", right - canvas.left, (right - canvas.left) * height],
            ["right", canvas.right - left, (canvas.right - left) * height],
          ];
          const [side, depth] = candidates.reduce((best, next) =>
            next[2] < best[2] ? next : best,
          );
          insets[side] = Math.max(insets[side], depth);
        }
        return insets;
      }
      
      /** The unobscured region in canvas-element (screen) coordinates. */
      export function usableArea(
        size: { width: number; height: number },
        insets: Insets,
        margin = 16,
      ): Box {
        const x = insets.left + margin;
        const y = insets.top + margin;
        return {
          x,
          y,
          // Never collapse entirely; a tiny window still gets a usable target.
          width: Math.max(40, size.width - insets.right - margin - x),
          height: Math.max(40, size.height - insets.bottom - margin - y),
        };
      }
      
      export function unionBox(boxes: Box[]): Box | undefined {
        if (!boxes.length) return undefined;
        const left = Math.min(...boxes.map((b) => b.x));
        const top = Math.min(...boxes.map((b) => b.y));
        const right = Math.max(...boxes.map((b) => b.x + b.width));
        const bottom = Math.max(...boxes.map((b) => b.y + b.height));
        return { x: left, y: top, width: right - left, height: bottom - top };
      }
      
      const clampZoom = (zoom: number) =>
        Math.min(LIMITS.maxZoom, Math.max(LIMITS.minZoom, zoom));
      
      /**
       * Viewport placing a canvas-space target inside the usable screen area.
       * Targets larger than the minimum zoom allows align their top-left corner so
       * a useful portion stays visible. Only the viewport is computed.
       */
      export function fitViewport(
        target: Box,
        area: Box,
        maxZoom = 1,
        padding = 24,
      ): Viewport {
        const fitZoom = Math.min(
          (area.width - padding * 2) / Math.max(target.width, 1),
          (area.height - padding * 2) / Math.max(target.height, 1),
        );
        const zoom = clampZoom(Math.min(fitZoom, maxZoom));
        const w = target.width * zoom;
        const h = target.height * zoom;
        const x =
          w <= area.width
            ? area.x + (area.width - w) / 2
            : area.x + Math.min(padding, area.width / 4);
        const y =
          h <= area.height
            ? area.y + (area.height - h) / 2
            : area.y + Math.min(padding, area.height / 4);
        return { x: x - target.x * zoom, y: y - target.y * zoom, zoom };
      }
      
      /** Zoom by a factor about the centre of the usable area. */
      export function zoomAbout(view: Viewport, area: Box, factor: number): Viewport {
        const zoom = clampZoom(view.zoom * factor);
        const cx = area.x + area.width / 2;
        const cy = area.y + area.height / 2;
        const worldX = (cx - view.x) / view.zoom;
        const worldY = (cy - view.y) / view.zoom;
        return { x: cx - worldX * zoom, y: cy - worldY * zoom, zoom };
      }
      
      /** Canvas-space point at the centre of the usable area. */
      export function areaCentre(view: Viewport, area: Box) {
        return {
          x: (area.x + area.width / 2 - view.x) / view.zoom,
          y: (area.y + area.height / 2 - view.y) / view.zoom,
        };
      }
      
      export type FitResult =
        | { ok: true; height: number }
        | { ok: false; reason: string };
      
      const overlaps = (a: Box, b: Box) =>
        a.x < b.x + b.width &&
        a.x + a.width > b.x &&
        a.y < b.y + b.height &&
        a.y + a.height > b.y;
      
      /**
       * Height that fits measured content, anchored at the node's top-left. Growth
       * is refused rather than moving neighbours when the new strip is occupied or
       * the result would exceed the protocol size limit.
       */
      export function fitTextHeight(
        node: Box & { id: string },
        requiredHeight: number,
        others: (Box & { id: string })[],
      ): FitResult {
        const height = Math.ceil(requiredHeight);
        if (height <= node.height)
          return { ok: false, reason: "The text already fits this object." };
        if (height > LIMITS.maxSize)
          return {
            ok: false,
            reason: `The text needs more than the ${LIMITS.maxSize}-unit size limit. Use Read to view it in full.`,
          };
        const strip = {
          x: node.x,
          y: node.y + node.height,
          width: node.width,
          height: height - node.height,
        };
        const blocked = others.find(
          (other) => other.id !== node.id && overlaps(strip, other),
        );
        if (blocked)
          return {
            ok: false,
            reason:
              "Another object occupies the space below. Move it or resize this object; you can still read the full text.",
          };
        return { ok: true, height };
      }
      
      /** Read-only text carried by a pending proposal, for the review disclosure. */
      export type ProposedContent = { title: string; text: string };
      
      type ContentOperation =
        | { op: "createText" | "updateText"; text: string }
        | { op: "createShape" | "updateShape"; kind: string; label?: string }
        | { op: string };
      
      export function proposedContent(
        operations: readonly ContentOperation[],
      ): ProposedContent[] {
        const items: ProposedContent[] = [];
        operations.forEach((operation, index) => {
          const step = `Change ${index + 1}`;
          if ("text" in operation)
            items.push({
              title: `${step}: ${operation.op === "createText" ? "new text" : "updated text"}`,
              text: operation.text,
            });
          else if ("label" in operation && operation.label)
            items.push({
              title: `${step}: ${operation.kind} label`,
              text: operation.label,
            });
        });
        return items;
      }
      
- path: apps\desktop\src\lib\canvas-agent.ts
  content: |
      import {
        CanvasOperationSchema,
        LIMITS,
        type CanvasOperation,
      } from "@agentica/protocol";
      import type { CanvasDocument } from "./editor.ts";
      import { EXCHANGE_RESERVE, type Box } from "./canvas-view.ts";
      
      type Context = Pick<CanvasDocument, "nodes" | "edges" | "artifacts">;
      
      export function exchangePosition(
        nodes: (Box & { id: string })[],
        selectedIds: string[],
        center: { x: number; y: number },
      ) {
        const selected = nodes.filter((node) => selectedIds.includes(node.id));
        let x = selected.length
          ? Math.max(...selected.map((n) => n.x + n.width)) + 64
          : center.x;
        const y = selected.length ? Math.min(...selected.map((n) => n.y)) : center.y;
        // Reserve room for the compact prompt and reply cards plus a nearby
        // diagram without moving user work; the runtime caps card heights to match.
        for (let attempts = 0; attempts <= nodes.length; attempts++) {
          const overlap = nodes.find(
            (n) =>
              n.x < x + EXCHANGE_RESERVE.width &&
              n.x + n.width > x - 32 &&
              n.y < y + EXCHANGE_RESERVE.height &&
              n.y + n.height > y - 32,
          );
          if (!overlap) return { x, y };
          x = overlap.x + overlap.width + 64;
        }
        throw new Error(
          "There is no room for this exchange. Pan to an open area and retry.",
        );
      }
      
      /** The model and preview use the same staged objects; the saved canvas stays untouched. */
      export function stageOperations(
        context: Context,
        operations: CanvasOperation[],
      ): Context {
        if (operations.length > 32)
          throw new Error("A turn supports at most 32 canvas changes.");
        const staged = structuredClone(context);
        for (const input of operations) {
          const operation = CanvasOperationSchema.parse(input);
          if (
            operation.op === "createText" ||
            operation.op === "createShape" ||
            operation.op === "createHtml"
          ) {
            if (
              staged.nodes.some((n) => n.id === operation.nodeId) ||
              staged.artifacts.some((a) => a.id === operation.artifactId)
            )
              throw new Error("Duplicate proposed object identity.");
            const { x, y, width, height, nodeId, artifactId } = operation;
            staged.nodes.push({ id: nodeId, artifactId, x, y, width, height });
            staged.artifacts.push(
              operation.op === "createText"
                ? {
                    id: artifactId,
                    type: "text",
                    schemaVersion: 1,
                    revision: 1,
                    text: operation.text,
                  }
                : operation.op === "createHtml"
                  ? {
                      id: artifactId,
                      type: "html",
                      schemaVersion: 1,
                      revision: 1,
                      html: operation.html,
                    }
                  : {
                      id: artifactId,
                      type: "drawing",
                      schemaVersion: 1,
                      revision: 1,
                      drawing: {
                        shapes: [
                          {
                            kind: operation.kind,
                            x: 0,
                            y: 0,
                            width,
                            height,
                            color: operation.color,
                            label: operation.label,
                          },
                        ],
                      },
                    },
            );
            continue;
          }
          if (operation.op === "connect") {
            if (
              operation.sourceNodeId === operation.targetNodeId ||
              ![operation.sourceNodeId, operation.targetNodeId].every((id) =>
                staged.nodes.some((n) => n.id === id),
              )
            )
              throw new Error(
                "Connect two different objects in the current context.",
              );
            if (
              staged.edges.some(
                (e) =>
                  e.id === operation.edgeId ||
                  (e.sourceNodeId === operation.sourceNodeId &&
                    e.targetNodeId === operation.targetNodeId),
              )
            )
              throw new Error("These objects are already connected.");
            staged.edges.push({
              id: operation.edgeId,
              kind: "relationship",
              sourceNodeId: operation.sourceNodeId,
              targetNodeId: operation.targetNodeId,
            });
            continue;
          }
          const node = staged.nodes.find((n) => n.id === operation.nodeId);
          if (!node) throw new Error("The target is outside this turn's context.");
          const artifact = staged.artifacts.find((a) => a.id === node.artifactId)!;
          if (operation.op === "place") {
            if (
              artifact.type === "drawing" &&
              (artifact.drawing.shapes.length !== 1 ||
                artifact.drawing.shapes[0]?.kind === "path") &&
              (operation.width !== node.width || operation.height !== node.height)
            )
              throw new Error("Freehand and composite drawings support moving only.");
            Object.assign(node, {
              x: operation.x,
              y: operation.y,
              width: operation.width,
              height: operation.height,
            });
          } else if (operation.op === "updateText") {
            if (artifact.type !== "text") throw new Error("The target is not text.");
            artifact.text = operation.text;
          } else {
            if (
              artifact.type !== "drawing" ||
              artifact.drawing.shapes.length !== 1 ||
              artifact.drawing.shapes[0]?.kind === "path"
            )
              throw new Error(
                "Only single rectangles and ellipses support shape edits.",
              );
            artifact.drawing.shapes = [
              {
                kind: operation.kind,
                x: 0,
                y: 0,
                width: node.width,
                height: node.height,
                color: operation.color,
                label: operation.label,
              },
            ];
          }
        }
        return staged;
      }
      
      export function checkedToolOperation(args: unknown): CanvasOperation {
        if (!args || typeof args !== "object" || Array.isArray(args))
          throw new Error("Canvas tool arguments must be an object.");
        const value = { ...args } as Record<string, unknown>;
        if (
          value.op === "createText" ||
          value.op === "createShape" ||
          value.op === "createHtml"
        ) {
          value.nodeId = crypto.randomUUID();
          value.artifactId = crypto.randomUUID();
        } else if (value.op === "connect") value.edgeId = crypto.randomUUID();
        const parsed = CanvasOperationSchema.safeParse(value);
        if (!parsed.success) {
          const details = parsed.error.issues
            .slice(0, 3)
            .map(
              (issue) => `${issue.path.join(".") || "operation"}: ${issue.message}`,
            )
            .join("; ")
            .slice(0, 500);
          throw new Error(
            `Invalid canvas operation: ${details}. Correct the fields and retry canvas_edit.`,
          );
        }
        return parsed.data;
      }
      
      export function textHeight(text: string, width = 340) {
        const columns = Math.max(1, Math.floor(width / 9));
        const lines = text
          .split("\n")
          .reduce(
            (sum, line) => sum + Math.max(1, Math.ceil(line.length / columns)),
            0,
          );
        return Math.min(LIMITS.maxSize, Math.max(160, lines * 24 + 32));
      }

  content: |
      import {
        MAX_FRAME_BYTES,
        type Drawing,
        type RuntimeResult,
        type RuntimeParams,
        type ConversationTurn,
        PROJECT_HEADER,
        PROJECT_PADDING,
        type ProjectGroup,
        type SessionTile,
      } from "@agentica/protocol";
      import type { callRuntime } from "./runtime";
      
      export type CanvasDocument = RuntimeResult<"canvas.open">;
      type Placement = CanvasDocument["nodes"][number];
      type Viewport = CanvasDocument["canvas"]["viewport"];
      type Artifact = CanvasDocument["artifacts"][number];
      
      /** One drawing to persist: where its node sits and what it contains. */
      export interface DrawingSegment {
        geometry: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
        drawing: Drawing;
      }
      
      /** Comparable content, so unsaved work is detected for every artifact type. */
      function content(artifact: Artifact): string {
        if (artifact.type === "text") return artifact.text;
        if (artifact.type === "html") return artifact.html;
        return JSON.stringify(artifact.drawing);
      }
      
      export interface EditorState {
        workspaces: RuntimeResult<"workspace.list">["workspaces"];
        workspace: RuntimeResult<"workspace.open"> | null;
        document: CanvasDocument | null;
        busy: boolean;
        saving: boolean;
        dirty: boolean;
        error: string;
        turns: ConversationTurn[];
      }
      
      // One buffer and save queue for either transport; acknowledgements never replace drafts.
      export class Editor {
        state: EditorState = {
          workspaces: [],
          workspace: null,
          document: null,
          busy: false,
          saving: false,
          dirty: false,
          error: "",
          turns: [],
        };
        private call: typeof callRuntime;
        private key: () => string;
        private changed: (state: EditorState) => void;
        private savedArtifacts = new Map<string, string>();
        private attemptedArtifacts = new Map<string, string>();
        private attemptedDrawing: {
          node: Placement;
          artifact: Artifact;
          revision: number;
        } | null = null;
        private nodeIds = new Map<string, string>();
        private savedLayout = "";
        private attemptedLayout = "";
        private savedProjectMetadata = "";
        private timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
        private mutations: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();
        private savingTask: Promise<void> | null = null;
        private disposed = false;
      
        constructor(
          call: typeof callRuntime,
          key: () => string,
          changed: (state: EditorState) => void,
        ) {
          this.call = call;
          this.key = key;
          this.changed = changed;
        }
      
        /**
         * Comparable layout for persistence. A node whose drawing has not been
         * created on the server yet is a draft: `canvas.save` only updates existing
         * nodes, so a pending node is left out until `node.createDrawing` returns.
         */
        private layout(document: CanvasDocument) {
          const pending = new Set(
            document.artifacts
              .filter((artifact) => !this.savedArtifacts.has(artifact.id))
              .map((artifact) => artifact.id),
          );
          return {
            viewport: document.canvas.viewport,
            nodes: document.nodes
              .filter((node) => !pending.has(node.artifactId))
              .map(({ id, x, y, width, height }) => ({
                id,
                x,
                y,
                width,
                height,
              }))
              .sort((left, right) => left.id.localeCompare(right.id)),
            ...((document.projectGroups ?? []).length
              ? {
                  projectGroups: document.projectGroups
                    .map(({ id, x, y, width, height, collapsed }) => ({
                      id,
                      x,
                      y,
                      width,
                      height,
                      collapsed,
                    }))
                    .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),
                }
              : {}),
            ...((document.sessionTiles ?? []).length
              ? {
                  sessionTiles: document.sessionTiles
                    .map(({ id, projectId, x, y, width, height }) => ({
                      id,
                      projectId,
                      x,
                      y,
                      width,
                      height,
                    }))
                    .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),
                }
              : {}),
          };
        }
      
        private publish(update: Partial<EditorState> = {}) {
          this.state = { ...this.state, ...update };
          const document = this.state.document;
          this.state.dirty =
            !!document &&
            (this.attemptedArtifacts.size > 0 ||
              !!this.attemptedLayout ||
              JSON.stringify(this.layout(document)) !== this.savedLayout ||
              document.artifacts.some(
                (artifact) =>
                  content(artifact) !== this.savedArtifacts.get(artifact.id),
              ));
          if (!this.disposed) this.changed(this.state);
        }
      
        private fail(error: unknown) {
          this.publish({
            error:
              typeof error === "string"
                ? error
                : error instanceof Error
                  ? error.message
                  : "The operation failed. Try again.",
          });
        }
      
        private load(document: CanvasDocument, turns?: ConversationTurn[]) {
          if (document.canvas.id !== this.state.document?.canvas.id) {
            this.nodeIds.clear();
            this.state = { ...this.state, turns: [] };
          }
          this.savedArtifacts = new Map(
            document.artifacts.map((artifact) => [artifact.id, content(artifact)]),
          );
          this.attemptedArtifacts.clear();
          this.attemptedDrawing = null;
          this.savedLayout = JSON.stringify(this.layout(document));
          this.savedProjectMetadata = this.projectMetadata(document);
          this.attemptedLayout = "";
          this.publish({ document, ...(turns ? { turns } : {}) });
        }
      
        private projectMetadata(document: CanvasDocument) {
          return JSON.stringify({
            groups: (document.projectGroups ?? [])
              .map(({ id, root, label }) => ({ id, root, label }))
              .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),
            tiles: (document.sessionTiles ?? [])
              .map(({ id, projectId, kind, preset }) => ({
                id,
                projectId,
                kind,
                preset,
              }))
              .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),
          });
        }
      
        private async projectMutation<T>(
          run: (reference: {
            workspaceId: string;
            canvasId: string;
            expectedRevision: number;
          }) => Promise<T>,
        ): Promise<T | undefined> {
          let result: T | undefined;
          await this.enqueue(async () => {
            await this.settleSave();
            const document = this.state.document;
            const workspaceId = this.state.workspace?.workspace.id;
            // A failed save must be recovered first; an earlier rejected mutation
            // (for example an invalid folder path) must not block a corrected retry.
            if (
              !document ||
              !workspaceId ||
              (this.state.dirty && this.state.error) ||
              this.disposed
            )
              return;
            await this.mutation(async () => {
              result = await run({
                workspaceId,
                canvasId: document.canvas.id,
                expectedRevision: document.canvas.revision,
              });
              this.load(
                await this.call(this.key(), false, "canvas.open", {
                  workspaceId,
                  canvasId: document.canvas.id,
                }),
              );
            });
          });
          return result;
        }
      
        async openProject(path: string, position?: { x: number; y: number }) {
          const document = this.state.document;
          if (!document) return;
          const view = document.canvas.viewport;
          let x = position?.x ?? (40 - view.x) / view.zoom;
          const y = position?.y ?? (40 - view.y) / view.zoom;
          for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= document.projectGroups.length; attempt++) {
            const overlap = document.projectGroups.find(
              (group) =>
                group.x < x + 680 + 32 &&
                group.x + group.width + 32 > x &&
                group.y < y + 600 + 32 &&
                group.y + (group.collapsed ? PROJECT_HEADER : group.height) + 32 > y,
            );
            if (!overlap) break;
            x = overlap.x + overlap.width + 48;
          }
          return this.projectMutation((reference) =>
            this.call(this.key(), false, "project.open", {
              ...reference,
              path,
              x,
              y,
              width: 680,
              height: 600,
            }),
          );
        }
      
        async deleteProject(projectId: string) {
          return this.projectMutation((reference) =>
            this.call(this.key(), false, "project.delete", {
              ...reference,
              projectId,
            }),
          );
        }
        async deleteSessionTile(tileId: string) {
          return this.projectMutation((reference) =>
            this.call(this.key(), false, "project.deleteTile", {
              ...reference,
              tileId,
            }),
          );
        }
      
        async locateProject(projectId: string, path: string) {
          return this.projectMutation((reference) =>
            this.call(this.key(), false, "project.locate", {
              ...reference,
              projectId,
              path,
            }),
          );
        }
      
        async addSessionTile(projectId: string, kind: "shell" | "cli-agent") {
          const document = this.state.document;
          if (!document) return;
          const tiles = (document.sessionTiles ?? []).filter(
            (tile) => tile.projectId === projectId,
          );
          const y = Math.max(
            PROJECT_HEADER,
            ...tiles.map((tile) => tile.y + tile.height + PROJECT_PADDING),
          );
          return this.projectMutation((reference) =>
            this.call(this.key(), false, "project.createTile", {
              ...reference,
              projectId,
              kind,
              ...(kind === "cli-agent" ? { preset: "codex" as const } : {}),
              x: PROJECT_PADDING,
              y,
              width: 576,
              height: 440,
              growProject: true,
            }),
          );
        }
      
        placeProject(
          id: string,
          geometry: Partial<
            Pick<ProjectGroup, "x" | "y" | "width" | "height" | "collapsed">
          >,
        ) {
          const document = this.state.document;
          const group = document?.projectGroups?.find((group) => group.id === id);
          if (!document || !group || this.state.busy) return;
          const tiles = document.sessionTiles.filter((tile) => tile.projectId === id);
          const minimumWidth = Math.max(
            320,
            ...tiles.map((tile) => tile.x + tile.width + PROJECT_PADDING),
          );
          const minimumHeight = Math.max(
            240,
            ...tiles.map((tile) => tile.y + tile.height + PROJECT_PADDING),
          );
          const next = {
            ...group,
            ...geometry,
            width: Math.max(
              minimumWidth,
              Math.min(4000, geometry.width ?? group.width),
            ),
            height: Math.max(
              minimumHeight,
              Math.min(4000, geometry.height ?? group.height),
            ),
          };
          if (JSON.stringify(next) === JSON.stringify(group)) return;
          this.edit({
            ...document,
            projectGroups: document.projectGroups.map((group) =>
              group.id === id ? next : group,
            ),
          });
        }
      
        placeSessionTile(
          id: string,
          geometry: Partial<Pick<SessionTile, "x" | "y" | "width" | "height">>,
        ) {
          const document = this.state.document;
          const tile = document?.sessionTiles?.find((tile) => tile.id === id);
          const group = document?.projectGroups?.find(
            (group) => group.id === tile?.projectId,
          );
          if (!document || !tile || !group || this.state.busy) return;
          const width = Math.max(
            240,
            Math.min(group.width - 2 * PROJECT_PADDING, geometry.width ?? tile.width),
          );
          const height = Math.max(
            160,
            Math.min(
              group.height - PROJECT_HEADER - PROJECT_PADDING,
              geometry.height ?? tile.height,
            ),
          );
          const next = {
            ...tile,
            ...geometry,
            width,
            height,
            x: Math.max(
              PROJECT_PADDING,
              Math.min(group.width - width - PROJECT_PADDING, geometry.x ?? tile.x),
            ),
            y: Math.max(
              PROJECT_HEADER,
              Math.min(group.height - height - PROJECT_PADDING, geometry.y ?? tile.y),
            ),
          };
          if (JSON.stringify(next) === JSON.stringify(tile)) return;
          this.edit({
            ...document,
            sessionTiles: document.sessionTiles.map((tile) =>
              tile.id === id ? next : tile,
            ),
          });
        }
      
        private async operation(run: () => Promise<void>) {
          if (
            this.state.busy ||
            this.state.saving ||
            this.state.dirty ||
            this.disposed
          )
            return;
          this.publish({ busy: true, error: "" });
          try {
            await run();
          } catch (error) {
            this.fail(error);
          } finally {
            this.publish({ busy: false });
          }
        }
      
        async listWorkspaces() {
          await this.operation(async () => {
            const { workspaces } = await this.call(
              this.key(),
              false,
              "workspace.list",
              {},
            );
            this.publish({ workspaces });
          });
        }
      
        async openWorkspace(workspaceId: string) {
          await this.operation(async () => {
            const workspace = await this.call(this.key(), false, "workspace.open", {
              workspaceId,
            });
            this.publish({ workspace, document: null });
          });
        }
      
        async createWorkspace(name: string) {
          await this.operation(async () => {
            const workspace = await this.call(this.key(), false, "workspace.create", {
              name,
            });
            this.publish({
              workspace,
              document: null,
              workspaces: [...this.state.workspaces, workspace.workspace],
            });
          });
        }
      
        async closeWorkspace() {
          await this.operation(async () => {
            const workspaceId = this.state.workspace?.workspace.id;
            if (!workspaceId) return;
            await this.call(this.key(), false, "workspace.close", { workspaceId });
            this.publish({ workspace: null, document: null });
          });
        }
      
        /** Remove a saved workspace from this device; the picker lists what is left. */
        async deleteWorkspace(workspaceId: string) {
          await this.operation(async () => {
            const { workspaces } = await this.call(
              this.key(),
              false,
              "workspace.delete",
              { workspaceId },
            );
            this.publish({ workspaces });
          });
        }
      
        /** Remove a saved canvas from the open workspace; the picker lists what is left. */
        async deleteCanvas(canvasId: string) {
          await this.operation(async () => {
            const workspace = this.state.workspace!;
            const { canvases } = await this.call(this.key(), false, "canvas.delete", {
              workspaceId: workspace.workspace.id,
              canvasId,
            });
            this.publish({ workspace: { ...workspace, canvases } });
          });
        }
      
        /** Persist one drawing; a stroke larger than one frame is split for you. */
        async addDrawing(
          geometry: Pick<Placement, "x" | "y" | "width" | "height">,
          drawing: Drawing,
        ) {
          await this.addDrawings([{ geometry, drawing }]);
        }
      
        /**
         * Persist several drawings in order. Creations queue behind pending saves and
         * every segment becomes a draft before any request, so a failure midway keeps
         * the rest recoverable and a retry creates only the missing segments.
         */
        async addDrawings(segments: DrawingSegment[]) {
          await this.enqueue(async () => {
            await this.settleSave();
            if (this.state.error || this.disposed) return;
            const document = this.state.document!;
            const workspaceId = this.state.workspace!.workspace.id;
            const additions = segments
              .flatMap((segment) =>
                this.splitSegment(workspaceId, document.canvas.id, segment),
              )
              .map((segment): { node: Placement; artifact: Artifact } => {
                const nodeId = crypto.randomUUID();
                const artifactId = crypto.randomUUID();
                return {
                  node: { id: nodeId, artifactId, ...segment.geometry },
                  artifact: {
                    id: artifactId,
                    type: "drawing",
                    schemaVersion: 1,
                    revision: 1,
                    drawing: segment.drawing,
                  },
                };
              });
            // Show every stroke at once. If creating one fails, the draft stays in the
            // document as a recoverable edit and `save` retries only the missing ones.
            this.publish({
              document: {
                ...document,
                nodes: [...document.nodes, ...additions.map((item) => item.node)],
                artifacts: [
                  ...document.artifacts,
                  ...additions.map((item) => item.artifact),
                ],
              },
            });
            await this.save();
          });
        }
      
        /**
         * Keep one request inside the frame limit. A single freehand path that is too
         * large becomes several nodes; consecutive segments share their boundary point
         * so the drawn line stays continuous.
         */
        private splitSegment(
          workspaceId: string,
          canvasId: string,
          segment: DrawingSegment,
        ): DrawingSegment[] {
          if (this.frameBytes(workspaceId, canvasId, segment) <= MAX_FRAME_BYTES)
            return [segment];
          const shape = segment.drawing.shapes[0];
          if (segment.drawing.shapes.length !== 1 || !shape || shape.kind !== "path")
            return [segment];
          const segments: DrawingSegment[] = [];
          let chunk: [number, number][] = [];
          for (const point of shape.points) {
            const candidate = [...chunk, point];
            const size = this.frameBytes(workspaceId, canvasId, {
              geometry: segment.geometry,
              drawing: { shapes: [{ ...shape, points: candidate }] },
            });
            if (chunk.length > 0 && size > MAX_FRAME_BYTES) {
              segments.push({
                geometry: segment.geometry,
                drawing: { shapes: [{ ...shape, points: chunk }] },
              });
              chunk = [chunk[chunk.length - 1]!, point];
            } else {
              chunk = candidate;
            }
          }
          segments.push({
            geometry: segment.geometry,
            drawing: { shapes: [{ ...shape, points: chunk }] },
          });
          return segments;
        }
      
        /** Upper bound on the serialized size of a `node.createDrawing` request. */
        private frameBytes(
          workspaceId: string,
          canvasId: string,
          segment: DrawingSegment,
        ): number {
          return new TextEncoder().encode(
            JSON.stringify({
              protocolVersion: 1,
              id: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000",
              method: "node.createDrawing",
              params: {
                workspaceId,
                canvasId,
                expectedRevision: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
                ...segment.geometry,
                drawing: segment.drawing,
              },
            }),
          ).length;
        }
      
        /** Remove one node (and its artifact when unreferenced); used by the eraser. */
        async deleteNode(nodeId: string) {
          await this.enqueue(async () => {
            await this.settleSave();
            if (this.state.error || this.disposed) return;
            nodeId = this.nodeIds.get(nodeId) ?? nodeId;
            await this.mutation(async () => {
              const document = this.state.document!;
              const result = await this.call(this.key(), false, "node.delete", {
                workspaceId: this.state.workspace!.workspace.id,
                canvasId: document.canvas.id,
                expectedRevision: document.canvas.revision,
                nodeId,
              });
              const nodes = document.nodes.filter((node) => node.id !== nodeId);
              const retained = new Set(nodes.map((node) => node.artifactId));
              this.load({
                ...document,
                canvas: { ...document.canvas, revision: result.revision },
                nodes,
                edges: document.edges.filter(
                  (edge) =>
                    edge.sourceNodeId !== nodeId && edge.targetNodeId !== nodeId,
                ),
                artifacts: document.artifacts.filter((artifact) =>
                  retained.has(artifact.id),
                ),
              });
            });
          });
        } /** Link two nodes already on the canvas; used by the arrow tool. */
        async createEdge(sourceNodeId: string, targetNodeId: string) {
          if (sourceNodeId === targetNodeId) return;
          await this.enqueue(async () => {
            await this.settleSave();
            if (this.state.error || this.disposed) return;
            await this.mutation(async () => {
              const document = this.state.document!;
              const result = await this.call(this.key(), false, "edge.create", {
                workspaceId: this.state.workspace!.workspace.id,
                canvasId: document.canvas.id,
                expectedRevision: document.canvas.revision,
                kind: "relationship",
                sourceNodeId,
                targetNodeId,
              });
              this.load({
                ...document,
                canvas: { ...document.canvas, revision: result.revision },
                edges: [...document.edges, result.edge],
              });
            });
          });
        }
      
        /** Flush debounced edits, including an in-flight save, before mutating. */
        private async settleSave() {
          if (this.savingTask) await this.savingTask;
          if (this.state.dirty && !this.state.error && !this.disposed)
            await this.save();
        }
      
        /** Run mutations one at a time, in the order they were requested. */
        private enqueue(run: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
          const next = this.mutations.then(run, run);
          this.mutations = next.then(
            () => undefined,
            () => undefined,
          );
          return next;
        }
      
        private async mutation(run: () => Promise<void>) {
          if (this.state.busy || this.state.saving || this.disposed) return;
          this.publish({ busy: true, error: "" });
          try {
            await run();
          } catch (error) {
            this.fail(error);
          } finally {
            this.publish({ busy: false });
          }
        }
      
        /** Leave the open canvas but keep its workspace, returning to canvas selection. */
        async closeCanvas() {
          await this.operation(async () => {
            if (this.state.document) this.publish({ document: null });
          });
        }
      
        async openCanvas(canvasId: string) {
          await this.operation(async () => {
            const workspaceId = this.state.workspace!.workspace.id;
            this.load(
              await this.call(this.key(), false, "canvas.open", {
                workspaceId,
                canvasId,
              }),
            );
            await this.refreshConversation();
          });
        }
      
        async createCanvas(title: string) {
          await this.operation(async () => {
            const workspace = this.state.workspace!;
            const workspaceId = workspace.workspace.id;
            const { canvas } = await this.call(this.key(), false, "canvas.create", {
              workspaceId,
              title,
            });
            this.publish({
              workspace: { ...workspace, canvases: [...workspace.canvases, canvas] },
            });
            this.load(
              await this.call(this.key(), false, "canvas.open", {
                workspaceId,
                canvasId: canvas.id,
              }),
            );
            await this.refreshConversation();
          });
        }
      
        async refreshConversation() {
          const canvasId = this.state.document?.canvas.id;
          const workspaceId = this.state.workspace?.workspace.id;
          if (!canvasId || !workspaceId) return;
          const result = await this.call(this.key(), false, "conversation.list", {
            workspaceId,
            canvasId,
            before: 0,
          });
          if (
            this.state.document?.canvas.id === canvasId &&
            this.state.workspace?.workspace.id === workspaceId
          )
            this.publish({ turns: result.turns });
        }
      
        private async reloadConversationCanvas() {
          const workspaceId = this.state.workspace!.workspace.id;
          const canvasId = this.state.document!.canvas.id;
          const document = await this.call(this.key(), false, "canvas.open", {
            workspaceId,
            canvasId,
          });
          const { turns } = await this.call(this.key(), false, "conversation.list", {
            workspaceId,
            canvasId,
            before: 0,
          });
          // Applied objects must never be rendered with an older pending proposal.
          this.load(document, turns);
        }
      
        async reloadConversation() {
          await this.enqueue(async () => {
            if (this.state.dirty || !this.state.document || this.disposed) return;
            await this.mutation(() => this.reloadConversationCanvas());
          });
        }
      
        async startConversation(params: RuntimeParams<"conversation.start">) {
          let result: RuntimeResult<"conversation.start"> | undefined;
          await this.enqueue(async () => {
            await this.settleSave();
            if (this.state.dirty || this.disposed) return;
            await this.mutation(async () => {
              result = await this.call(
                this.key(),
                false,
                "conversation.start",
                params,
              );
              await this.reloadConversationCanvas();
            });
          });
          return result;
        }
      
        async finishConversation(params: RuntimeParams<"conversation.finish">) {
          let result: RuntimeResult<"conversation.finish"> | undefined;
          await this.enqueue(async () => {
            await this.settleSave();
            if (this.state.dirty || this.disposed) return;
            await this.mutation(async () => {
              result = await this.call(
                this.key(),
                false,
                "conversation.finish",
                params,
              );
              await this.reloadConversationCanvas();
            });
          });
          return result;
        }
      
        /**
         * Reload the canvas and return the turn if the runtime already finished it.
         * A finish whose acknowledgement was lost is committed, so its buffered reply
         * must be adopted rather than resent or altered.
         */
        async finishedTurn(turnId: string) {
          let finished: ConversationTurn | undefined;
          await this.enqueue(async () => {
            await this.settleSave();
            if (this.state.dirty || !this.state.document || this.disposed) return;
            await this.mutation(async () => {
              await this.reloadConversationCanvas();
              finished = this.state.turns.find(
                (turn) => turn.id === turnId && turn.status !== "generating",
              );
            });
          });
          return finished;
        }
      
        async resolveConversation(turnId: string, action: "apply" | "discard") {
          await this.enqueue(async () => {
            await this.settleSave();
            if (this.state.dirty || this.disposed) return;
            await this.mutation(async () => {
              await this.call(this.key(), false, "conversation.resolve", {
                workspaceId: this.state.workspace!.workspace.id,
                canvasId: this.state.document!.canvas.id,
                turnId,
                action,
              });
              await this.reloadConversationCanvas();
            });
          });
        }
      
        async addText(
          position?: { x: number; y: number },
          text = "",
          size?: { width: number; height: number },
          origin?: { workspaceId: string; canvasId: string },
          purpose?: RuntimeParams<"node.createText">["purpose"],
        ): Promise<RuntimeResult<"node.createText"> | undefined> {
          let created: RuntimeResult<"node.createText"> | undefined;
          await this.enqueue(async () => {
            await this.settleSave();
            if (this.state.error || this.disposed) return;
            await this.mutation(async () => {
              const document = this.state.document;
              const workspaceId = this.state.workspace?.workspace.id;
      
              if (
                !document ||
                !workspaceId ||
                (origin &&
                  (origin.workspaceId !== workspaceId ||
                    origin.canvasId !== document.canvas.id))
              )
                return;
              const { x, y, zoom } = document.canvas.viewport;
              const params = {
                workspaceId,
                canvasId: document.canvas.id,
                expectedRevision: document.canvas.revision,
                x: position ? position.x : (40 - x) / zoom,
                y: position ? position.y : (40 - y) / zoom,
                width: size?.width ?? 240,
                height: size?.height ?? 160,
                text,
                ...(purpose ? { purpose } : {}),
              };
      
              const result = await this.call(
                this.key(),
                false,
                "node.createText",
                params,
              );
              created = result;
              this.load({
                ...document,
                canvas: { ...document.canvas, revision: result.revision },
                nodes: [...document.nodes, result.node],
                artifacts: [...document.artifacts, result.artifact],
              });
            });
          });
          return created;
        }
      
        editText(artifactId: string, text: string) {
          const document = this.state.document;
          if (!document || this.state.busy) return;
          this.edit({
            ...document,
            artifacts: document.artifacts.map((artifact) =>
              artifact.id === artifactId ? { ...artifact, text } : artifact,
            ),
          });
        }
      
        placeNode(
          id: string,
          geometry: Partial<Pick<Placement, "x" | "y" | "width" | "height">>,
        ) {
          const document = this.state.document;
          if (!document || this.state.busy) return;
          const node = document.nodes.find((item) => item.id === id);
          if (
            !node ||
            Object.entries(geometry).every(
              ([key, value]) => node[key as keyof Placement] === value,
            )
          )
            return;
          this.edit({
            ...document,
            nodes: document.nodes.map((node) =>
              node.id === id ? { ...node, ...geometry } : node,
            ),
          });
        }
      
        setViewport(viewport: Viewport) {
          const document = this.state.document;
          if (!document || this.state.busy) return;
          if (JSON.stringify(viewport) === JSON.stringify(document.canvas.viewport))
            return;
          this.edit({ ...document, canvas: { ...document.canvas, viewport } });
        }
      
        private edit(document: CanvasDocument) {
          this.publish({ document });
          clearTimeout(this.timer);
          if (this.state.dirty && !this.state.error && !this.disposed)
            this.timer = setTimeout(() => void this.save(), 400);
        }
      
        /** One save runs at a time; concurrent callers await the same attempt. */
        async save() {
          if (this.savingTask) return this.savingTask;
          this.savingTask = this.runSave();
          try {
            await this.savingTask;
          } finally {
            this.savingTask = null;
          }
        }
      
        /** Adopt server identities while keeping geometry edited during the request. */
        private acknowledgeDrawing(
          node: Placement,
          result: RuntimeResult<"node.createDrawing">,
        ) {
          this.savedArtifacts.set(result.artifact.id, content(result.artifact));
          const saved = JSON.parse(this.savedLayout) as ReturnType<Editor["layout"]>;
          saved.nodes = [
            ...saved.nodes,
            {
              id: result.node.id,
              x: result.node.x,
              y: result.node.y,
              width: result.node.width,
              height: result.node.height,
            },
          ].sort((left, right) => left.id.localeCompare(right.id));
          this.savedLayout = JSON.stringify(saved);
          this.nodeIds.set(node.id, result.node.id);
          this.attemptedDrawing = null;
          const latest = this.state.document!;
          this.publish({
            document: {
              ...latest,
              canvas: { ...latest.canvas, revision: result.revision },
              nodes: latest.nodes.map((item) =>
                item.id === node.id
                  ? { ...item, id: result.node.id, artifactId: result.artifact.id }
                  : item,
              ),
              artifacts: latest.artifacts.map((item) =>
                item.id === node.artifactId ? result.artifact : item,
              ),
            },
          });
        }
      
        private async runSave() {
          clearTimeout(this.timer);
          if (
            this.state.busy ||
            this.state.saving ||
            this.state.error ||
            this.disposed
          )
            return;
          this.publish({ saving: true });
          try {
            while (this.state.dirty && !this.disposed) {
              const workspaceId = this.state.workspace!.workspace.id;
              // A drawing whose creation failed is still a draft; create it now so a
              // retry persists each stroke exactly once.
              for (;;) {
                const draft = this.state.document!;
                const pending = draft.artifacts.find(
                  (artifact): artifact is Extract<Artifact, { type: "drawing" }> =>
                    artifact.type === "drawing" &&
                    !this.savedArtifacts.has(artifact.id),
                );
                if (!pending) break;
                const node = draft.nodes.find(
                  (item) => item.artifactId === pending.id,
                )!;
                this.attemptedDrawing = {
                  node,
                  artifact: pending,
                  revision: draft.canvas.revision,
                };
                const result = await this.call(
                  this.key(),
                  false,
                  "node.createDrawing",
                  {
                    workspaceId,
                    canvasId: draft.canvas.id,
                    expectedRevision: draft.canvas.revision,
                    x: node.x,
                    y: node.y,
                    width: node.width,
                    height: node.height,
                    drawing: pending.drawing,
                  },
                );
                this.acknowledgeDrawing(node, result);
              }
              const document = this.state.document!;
              for (const artifact of document.artifacts) {
                if (content(artifact) === this.savedArtifacts.get(artifact.id))
                  continue;
                // Drawings are immutable once created; only text content is edited.
                if (artifact.type !== "text") continue;
                this.attemptedArtifacts.set(artifact.id, artifact.text);
                const result = await this.call(
                  this.key(),
                  false,
                  "artifact.saveText",
                  {
                    workspaceId,
                    artifactId: artifact.id,
                    expectedRevision: artifact.revision,
                    text: artifact.text,
                  },
                );
                this.savedArtifacts.set(artifact.id, artifact.text);
                this.attemptedArtifacts.delete(artifact.id);
                const current = this.state.document!;
                this.publish({
                  document: {
                    ...current,
                    artifacts: current.artifacts.map((draft) =>
                      draft.id === artifact.id
                        ? { ...draft, revision: result.artifact.revision }
                        : draft,
                    ),
                  },
                });
              }
              const current = this.state.document!;
              const snapshot = this.layout(current);
              const serialized = JSON.stringify(snapshot);
              if (serialized !== this.savedLayout) {
                this.attemptedLayout = serialized;
                const { projectGroups, sessionTiles, ...baseLayout } = snapshot;
                const result = await this.call(this.key(), false, "canvas.save", {
                  workspaceId,
                  canvasId: current.canvas.id,
                  expectedRevision: current.canvas.revision,
                  ...baseLayout,
                  ...(projectGroups
                    ? {
                        projectGroups: projectGroups.map((group) => ({
                          ...group,
                          expectedRevision: current.projectGroups.find(
                            (item) => item.id === group.id,
                          )!.revision,
                        })),
                      }
                    : {}),
                  ...(sessionTiles
                    ? {
                        sessionTiles: sessionTiles.map((tile) => ({
                          ...tile,
                          expectedRevision: current.sessionTiles.find(
                            (item) => item.id === tile.id,
                          )!.revision,
                        })),
                      }
                    : {}),
                });
                this.savedLayout = serialized;
                this.attemptedLayout = "";
                const latest = this.state.document!;
                this.publish({
                  document: {
                    ...latest,
                    canvas: { ...latest.canvas, revision: result.revision },
                    ...((current.projectGroups ?? []).length
                      ? {
                          projectGroups: latest.projectGroups.map((group) => ({
                            ...group,
                            revision:
                              current.projectGroups.find(
                                (item) => item.id === group.id,
                              )!.revision + 1,
                          })),
                        }
                      : {}),
                    ...((current.sessionTiles ?? []).length
                      ? {
                          sessionTiles: latest.sessionTiles.map((tile) => ({
                            ...tile,
                            revision:
                              current.sessionTiles.find(
                                (item) => item.id === tile.id,
                              )!.revision + 1,
                          })),
                        }
                      : {}),
                  },
                });
              }
            }
          } catch (error) {
            this.fail(error);
          } finally {
            this.publish({ saving: false });
          }
        }
      
        async retrySave() {
          if (
            this.state.busy ||
            this.state.saving ||
            !this.state.document ||
            this.disposed
          )
            return;
          this.publish({ busy: true });
          try {
            let document = this.state.document;
            const workspaceId = this.state.workspace!.workspace.id;
            await this.call(this.key(), false, "workspace.open", { workspaceId });
            const remote = await this.call(this.key(), false, "canvas.open", {
              workspaceId,
              canvasId: document.canvas.id,
            });
            if (this.projectMetadata(remote) !== this.savedProjectMetadata)
              throw new Error(
                "Saved project associations changed elsewhere. Copy your unsaved edits before reloading.",
              );
            // One lost creation reply can account for exactly one new drawing and revision.
            const attempted = this.attemptedDrawing;
            const unknown = remote.artifacts.filter(
              (artifact) => !this.savedArtifacts.has(artifact.id),
            );
            const artifact = unknown.length === 1 ? unknown[0] : undefined;
            const placements = remote.nodes.filter(
              (node) => node.artifactId === artifact?.id,
            );
            const node = placements.length === 1 ? placements[0] : undefined;
            const created =
              attempted &&
              artifact?.type === "drawing" &&
              artifact.revision === 1 &&
              content(artifact) === content(attempted.artifact) &&
              node &&
              !document.nodes.some((item) => item.id === node.id) &&
              node.x === attempted.node.x &&
              node.y === attempted.node.y &&
              node.width === attempted.node.width &&
              node.height === attempted.node.height &&
              remote.canvas.revision === attempted.revision + 1
                ? { node, artifact, revision: remote.canvas.revision }
                : undefined;
            const pending = new Set(
              document.artifacts
                .filter((artifact) => !this.savedArtifacts.has(artifact.id))
                .map((artifact) => artifact.id),
            );
            // A lost reply may have committed. Accept only known content before retrying.
            const remoteLayout = JSON.stringify(this.layout(remote));
            if (
              remoteLayout !== this.savedLayout &&
              remoteLayout !== this.attemptedLayout
            )
              throw new Error(
                "Saved placement or view changed elsewhere. Copy your unsaved edits for recovery.",
              );
            const existing = remote.artifacts.filter(
              (artifact) => artifact.id !== created?.artifact.id,
            );
            for (const artifact of existing) {
              const known = content(artifact);
              if (
                known !== this.savedArtifacts.get(artifact.id) &&
                known !== this.attemptedArtifacts.get(artifact.id)
              )
                throw new Error(
                  "Saved text changed elsewhere. Copy your unsaved edits for recovery.",
                );
            }
            const committed = document.artifacts.filter(
              (artifact) => !pending.has(artifact.id),
            );
            if (existing.length !== committed.length)
              throw new Error(
                "Saved artifacts changed elsewhere. Copy your unsaved edits for recovery.",
              );
            if (created && attempted) {
              this.acknowledgeDrawing(attempted.node, created);
              document = this.state.document!;
              pending.delete(attempted.artifact.id);
            }
            this.attemptedDrawing = null;
            this.savedLayout = JSON.stringify(this.layout(remote));
            this.savedArtifacts = new Map(
              remote.artifacts.map((artifact) => [artifact.id, content(artifact)]),
            );
            this.attemptedArtifacts.clear();
            this.attemptedLayout = "";
            this.publish({
              error: "",
              document: {
                ...document,
                canvas: { ...document.canvas, revision: remote.canvas.revision },
                ...((document.projectGroups ?? []).length
                  ? {
                      projectGroups: document.projectGroups.map((group) => ({
                        ...group,
                        revision: remote.projectGroups.find(
                          (item) => item.id === group.id,
                        )!.revision,
                        available: remote.projectGroups.find(
                          (item) => item.id === group.id,
                        )!.available,
                      })),
                    }
                  : {}),
                ...((document.sessionTiles ?? []).length
                  ? {
                      sessionTiles: document.sessionTiles.map((tile) => ({
                        ...tile,
                        revision: remote.sessionTiles.find(
                          (item) => item.id === tile.id,
                        )!.revision,
                      })),
                    }
                  : {}),
                artifacts: document.artifacts.map((draft) =>
                  pending.has(draft.id)
                    ? draft
                    : {
                        ...draft,
                        revision: remote.artifacts.find(
                          (artifact) => artifact.id === draft.id,
                        )!.revision,
                      },
                ),
              },
            });
          } catch (error) {
            this.fail(error);
          } finally {
            this.publish({ busy: false });
          }
          if (!this.state.error) await this.save();
        }
      
        recovery() {
          return JSON.stringify(
            { workspace: this.state.workspace?.workspace, ...this.state.document },
            null,
            2,
          );
        }
      
        dispose() {
          this.disposed = true;
          clearTimeout(this.timer);
        }
      }

//! M1 contracts. Mind-map operations and agent execution remain capability gated.

use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::Value;

use crate::commands::{id, invalid, label, revision, text};
use crate::store::RuntimeError;

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "op", deny_unknown_fields, rename_all_fields = "camelCase")]
pub(crate) enum ArtifactOperation {
    #[serde(rename = "text.replace")]
    ReplaceText {
        artifact_id: String,
        expected_revision: f64,
        text: String,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "mindmap.addTopic")]
    AddTopic {
        artifact_id: String,
        expected_revision: f64,
        topic_id: String,
        #[serde(deserialize_with = "nullable_parent")]
        parent_id: Option<String>,
        title: String,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "mindmap.renameTopic")]
    RenameTopic {
        artifact_id: String,
        expected_revision: f64,
        topic_id: String,
        title: String,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "mindmap.moveTopic")]
    MoveTopic {
        artifact_id: String,
        expected_revision: f64,
        topic_id: String,
        #[serde(deserialize_with = "nullable_parent")]
        parent_id: Option<String>,
    },
    #[serde(rename = "mindmap.removeTopic")]
    RemoveTopic {
        artifact_id: String,
        expected_revision: f64,
        topic_id: String,
    },
}

fn nullable_parent<'de, D: serde::Deserializer<'de>>(
    deserializer: D,
) -> Result<Option<String>, D::Error> {
    Option::<String>::deserialize(deserializer)
}

impl ArtifactOperation {
    pub(crate) fn reference(&self) -> (&str, f64) {
        match self {
            Self::ReplaceText {
                artifact_id,
                expected_revision,
                ..
            }
            | Self::AddTopic {
                artifact_id,
                expected_revision,
                ..
            }
            | Self::RenameTopic {
                artifact_id,
                expected_revision,
                ..
            }
            | Self::MoveTopic {
                artifact_id,
                expected_revision,
                ..
            }
            | Self::RemoveTopic {
                artifact_id,
                expected_revision,
                ..
            } => (artifact_id, *expected_revision),
        }
    }

    fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        let (artifact_id, expected) = self.reference();
        id("artifactId", artifact_id)?;
        revision(expected)?;
        match self {
            Self::ReplaceText { text: body, .. } => text(body),
            Self::AddTopic {
                topic_id,
                parent_id,
                title,
                ..
            } => {
                label("title", title)?;
                topic(topic_id, parent_id.as_deref())
            }
            Self::MoveTopic {
                topic_id,
                parent_id,
                ..
            } => topic(topic_id, parent_id.as_deref()),
            Self::RenameTopic {
                topic_id, title, ..
            } => {
                id("topicId", topic_id)?;
                label("title", title)
            }
            Self::RemoveTopic { topic_id, .. } => id("topicId", topic_id),
        }
    }
}

fn topic(topic_id: &str, parent_id: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    id("topicId", topic_id)?;
    if let Some(parent_id) = parent_id {
        id("parentId", parent_id)?;
        if parent_id == topic_id {
            return Err(invalid("A topic cannot parent itself."));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", deny_unknown_fields)]
pub(crate) struct ArtifactBatch {
    pub workspace_id: String,
    pub canvas_id: String,
    pub operations: Vec<ArtifactOperation>,
}

impl ArtifactBatch {
    pub(crate) fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        id("workspaceId", &self.workspace_id)?;
        id("canvasId", &self.canvas_id)?;
        if self.operations.is_empty() || self.operations.len() > 32 {
            return Err(invalid("A batch must contain 1 to 32 operations."));
        }
        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        for operation in &self.operations {
            operation.validate()?;
            if !seen.insert(operation.reference().0) {
                return Err(invalid("Use one operation per artifact in a batch."));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub(crate) fn validate_agent_start(params: Value) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    #[derive(Deserialize)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", deny_unknown_fields)]
    struct Start {
        workspace_id: String,
        canvas_id: String,
        instruction_artifact_id: String,
        read_artifact_ids: Vec<String>,
        write_artifact_ids: Vec<String>,
    }
    let scope: Start =
        serde_json::from_value(params).map_err(|e| invalid(format!("Invalid run scope: {e}.")))?;
    id("workspaceId", &scope.workspace_id)?;
    id("canvasId", &scope.canvas_id)?;
    id("instructionArtifactId", &scope.instruction_artifact_id)?;
    for ids in [&scope.read_artifact_ids, &scope.write_artifact_ids] {
        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        if ids.len() > 128 {
            return Err(invalid("Run scopes are limited to 128 artifacts."));
        }
        for artifact_id in ids {
            id("artifactId", artifact_id)?;
            if !seen.insert(artifact_id) {
                return Err(invalid("Scope IDs must be unique."));
            }
        }
    }
    if !scope
        .read_artifact_ids
        .contains(&scope.instruction_artifact_id)
        || scope
            .write_artifact_ids
            .iter()
            .any(|id| !scope.read_artifact_ids.contains(id))
    {
        return Err(invalid(
            "Instructions and writable artifacts must be in the read scope.",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

import { isTauri, invoke } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import {
  MAX_FRAME_BYTES,
  ResultSchemas,
  RuntimeRequestSchema,
  RuntimeResponseSchema,
  type RuntimeErrorCode,
  type RuntimeMethod,
  type RuntimeParams,
  type RuntimeRequest,
  type RuntimeResult,
} from "@agentica/protocol";

export const desktopMode = isTauri();

/** A runtime error; `code` is absent for transport and validation failures. */
export class RuntimeCallError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    readonly code?: RuntimeErrorCode,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}

type ParamsFor<M extends RuntimeMethod> = M extends keyof typeof ResultSchemas
  ? M extends "runtime.ping"
    ? []
    : [params: RuntimeParams<Exclude<M, "runtime.ping">>]
  : never;

/** Send one validated request through the desktop or detached transport. */
export async function callRuntime<M extends RuntimeMethod>(
  connectionKey: string,
  connect: boolean,
  method: M,
  ...[params]: ParamsFor<M>
): Promise<RuntimeResult<M>> {
  const request = {
    protocolVersion: 1,
    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
    method,
    ...(params === undefined ? {} : { params }),
  } as RuntimeRequest;
  if (!RuntimeRequestSchema.safeParse(request).success)
    throw new RuntimeCallError("The request is invalid and was not sent.");
  const body = JSON.stringify(request);
  if (new TextEncoder().encode(body).length > MAX_FRAME_BYTES)
    throw new RuntimeCallError(
      "The change is larger than 16 KiB and was not sent.",
    );
  let reply: unknown;
  if (desktopMode) {
    reply = await invoke("runtime_request", { request, connect });
  } else {
    const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:1421/rpc", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        Authorization: `Bearer ${connectionKey}`,
      },
      body,
      signal: method === "runtime.ping" ? AbortSignal.timeout(3000) : undefined,
      cache: "no-store",
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new RuntimeCallError(await response.text());
    reply = await response.json();
  }
  const parsed = RuntimeResponseSchema.safeParse(reply);
  if (!parsed.success)
    throw new RuntimeCallError(
      "The backend returned an invalid protocol response.",
    );
  const response = parsed.data;
  if (response.id !== null && response.id !== request.id)
    throw new RuntimeCallError("The backend returned an unrelated response.");
  if ("error" in response)
    throw new RuntimeCallError(response.error.message, response.error.code);
  const result = ResultSchemas[method].safeParse(response.result);
  if (!result.success)
    throw new RuntimeCallError(
      "The backend returned an invalid protocol response.",
    );
  return result.data as RuntimeResult<M>;
}

export async function pingRuntime(connectionKey: string, connect: boolean) {
  await callRuntime(connectionKey, connect, "runtime.ping");
}
