pub(super) fn call(tx: &Transaction, method: &str, params: Value) -> Result<Value, RuntimeError> {
    let canvas_id = params
        .get("canvasId")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .ok_or_else(|| invalid("canvasId is required."))?;
    id("canvasId", canvas_id)?;
    canvas_revision(tx, canvas_id)?;
    match method {
        "conversation.start" => {
            let p: Start = parse(params)?;
            id("workspaceId", &p.workspace_id)?;
            id("turnId", &p.turn_id)?;
            text(&p.prompt)?;
            label("model", &p.model)?;
            if p.prompt.trim().is_empty() {
                return Err(invalid("A prompt is required."));
            }
            let duplicate: bool = tx.query_row(
                "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conversation_turn WHERE id = ?1)",
                [&p.turn_id],
                |r| r.get(0),
            )?;
            if duplicate {
                return Err(RuntimeError::new(
                    "CONFLICT",
                    "This turn already exists. Reload the conversation instead of resending.",
                ));
            }
            let active: bool = tx.query_row("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conversation_turn WHERE canvas_id = ?1 AND status IN ('generating','pending'))", [&p.canvas_id], |r| r.get(0))?;
            if active {
                return Err(RuntimeError::new("CONFLICT", "Resolve the current proposal or interrupt the active turn before sending another prompt."));
            }
            if p.node_ids.len() > 128
                || p.node_ids.iter().collect::<HashSet<_>>().len() != p.node_ids.len()
            {
                return Err(invalid("Select at most 128 unique objects."));
            }
            for n in &p.node_ids {
                id("nodeIds", n)?;
            }
            let state = canvas_state(tx, &p.canvas_id)?;
            let nodes: Vec<_> = state["nodes"]
                .as_array()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .filter(|n| {
                    (p.node_ids.is_empty()
                        && !matches!(p.context_mode, Some(ContextMode::Selection)))
                        || p.node_ids.iter().any(|id| n["id"] == *id)
                })
                .cloned()
                .collect();
            if !p.node_ids.is_empty() && nodes.len() != p.node_ids.len() {
                return Err(not_found("Selected object"));
            }
            let artifacts: Vec<_> = state["artifacts"]
                .as_array()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .filter(|a| nodes.iter().any(|n| n["artifactId"] == a["id"]))
                .cloned()
                .collect();
            let edges: Vec<_> = state["edges"]
                .as_array()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .filter(|e| {
                    nodes.iter().any(|n| n["id"] == e["sourceNodeId"])
                        && nodes.iter().any(|n| n["id"] == e["targetNodeId"])
                })
                .cloned()
                .collect();
            let context = json!({"nodes": nodes, "artifacts": artifacts, "edges": edges});
            let context_bytes = context.to_string().len();
            if context_bytes > crate::MAX_CANVAS_CONTEXT_BYTES {
                return Err(invalid(format!(
                    "Canvas context is {} KiB; the limit is 256 KiB. Select fewer objects or use a new canvas.",
                    context_bytes.div_ceil(1024)
                )));
            }
            let mut prior = history(tx, &p.canvas_id, 0)?;
            prior.reverse();
            let prior: Vec<_> = prior
                .iter()
                .map(|t| json!({"prompt": t["prompt"], "reply": t["reply"], "status": t["status"]}))
                .collect();
            let node_id = new_id()?;
            let g = open_position(
                tx,
                &p.canvas_id,
                Geometry {
                    x: p.anchor.x,
                    y: p.anchor.y,
                    width: CARD_WIDTH,
                    height: card_height(&p.prompt),
                },
            )?;
            insert_node(
                tx,
                &p.canvas_id,
                &node_id,
                &new_id()?,
                &g,
                &p.prompt,
                "text",
            )?;
            tx.execute("INSERT INTO conversation_turn(id,canvas_id,model,prompt,prompt_node_id,anchor,context,status) VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,?7,'generating')", (&p.turn_id,&p.canvas_id,&p.model,&p.prompt,&node_id,json!({"x":g.x,"y":g.y}).to_string(),context.to_string()))?;
            bump(tx, &p.canvas_id, canvas_revision(tx, &p.canvas_id)?)?;
            Ok(
                json!({"turn":turn(tx,&p.canvas_id,&p.turn_id)?, "context":context, "history":prior}),
            )
        }
        "conversation.finish" => {
            let p: Finish = parse(params)?;
            id("workspaceId", &p.workspace_id)?;
            id("turnId", &p.turn_id)?;
            text(&p.reply)?;
            text(&p.error)?;
            if !matches!(
                p.status.as_str(),
                "complete" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "interrupted"
            ) {
                return Err(invalid("Invalid completion status."));
            }
            if p.status != "complete" && (!p.operations.is_empty() || !p.reply.is_empty()) {
                return Err(invalid(
                    "Failed or interrupted turns cannot propose changes.",
                ));
            }
            let t = turn(tx, &p.canvas_id, &p.turn_id)?;
            if t["status"] != "generating" {
                let expected_status = if p.status == "complete" && !p.operations.is_empty() {
                    "pending"
                } else {
                    &p.status
                };
                if (t["status"] == expected_status
                    || (p.status == "complete"
                        && matches!(t["status"].as_str(), Some("applied" | "discarded"))))
                    && t["reply"] == p.reply
                    && t["operations"] == json!(p.operations)
                    && t["error"] == p.error
                {
                    return Ok(json!({"turn":t}));
                }
                return Err(RuntimeError::new(
                    "CONFLICT",
                    "This turn has already finished. Reload the conversation.",
                ));
            }
            if p.status == "complete" && p.reply.trim().is_empty() {
                return Err(invalid("The agent must provide a text reply."));
            }
            if !p.operations.is_empty() {
                let context: String = tx.query_row(
                    "SELECT context FROM conversation_turn WHERE id = ?1",
                    [&p.turn_id],
                    |r| r.get(0),
                )?;
                tx.execute_batch("SAVEPOINT proposal_validation")?;
                let validated = apply_operations(tx, &p.canvas_id, &json(&context)?, &p.operations);
                tx.execute_batch("ROLLBACK TO proposal_validation; RELEASE proposal_validation")?;
                validated?;
            }
            let reply_node_id = if p.status == "complete" {
                let node_id = new_id()?;
                let prompt_node: Option<(f64, f64, f64)> = tx
                    .query_row(
                        "SELECT x,y,height FROM canvas_node WHERE id = ?1",
                        [t["promptNodeId"].as_str().unwrap()],
                        |r| Ok((r.get(0)?, r.get(1)?, r.get(2)?)),
                    )
                    .optional()?;
                let (x, y, height) = prompt_node.unwrap_or((
                    t["anchor"]["x"].as_f64().unwrap(),
                    t["anchor"]["y"].as_f64().unwrap(),
                    CARD_MIN_HEIGHT,
                ));
                let g = open_position(
                    tx,
                    &p.canvas_id,
                    Geometry {
                        x,
                        y: y + height + 32.0,
                        width: CARD_WIDTH,
                        height: card_height(&p.reply),
                    },

```

-- Project references and stopped launch presets; terminal bytes and process IDs
-- belong to the backend-lifetime supervisor, never workspace persistence.
CREATE TABLE project_group (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    canvas_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES canvas(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    root TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(root) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),
    label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
    x REAL NOT NULL CHECK (x BETWEEN -1000000 AND 1000000),
    y REAL NOT NULL CHECK (y BETWEEN -1000000 AND 1000000),
    -- Width and height always retain the expanded layout, even while collapsed.
    width REAL NOT NULL CHECK (width BETWEEN 320 AND 4000),
    height REAL NOT NULL CHECK (height BETWEEN 240 AND 4000),
    collapsed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (collapsed IN (0, 1)),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
    UNIQUE (canvas_id, id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE session_tile (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    canvas_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('shell', 'cli-agent')),
    preset TEXT,
    x REAL NOT NULL CHECK (x BETWEEN 16 AND 4000),
    y REAL NOT NULL CHECK (y BETWEEN 96 AND 4000),
    width REAL NOT NULL CHECK (width BETWEEN 240 AND 4000),
    height REAL NOT NULL CHECK (height BETWEEN 160 AND 4000),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
    CHECK ((kind = 'shell' AND preset IS NULL)
        OR (kind = 'cli-agent' AND preset IS NOT NULL AND preset = 'codex')),
    FOREIGN KEY (canvas_id, project_id) REFERENCES project_group(canvas_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) STRICT;

    #[test]
    fn legacy_workspaces_upgrade_without_data_loss() {
        let _serial = serial();
        for old_version in [1, 2] {
            let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
            let id = new_id().unwrap();
            let dir = workspaces_dir(Some(temp.path())).unwrap().join(&id);
            fs::create_dir(&dir).unwrap();
            // Build each legacy storage version with real rows.
            let mut conn = connect(&dir.join(DATABASE_FILE), true).unwrap();
            let tx = conn
                .transaction_with_behavior(TransactionBehavior::Immediate)
                .unwrap();
            migrate(&tx, 0, &MIGRATIONS[..old_version]).unwrap();
            tx.execute(
                "INSERT INTO workspace (id, name) VALUES (?1, 'Legacy')",
                [&id],
            )
            .unwrap();
            tx.execute(
                "INSERT INTO canvas (id, title, revision, viewport_x, viewport_y, viewport_zoom)
             VALUES ('c', 'Plan', 1, 0, 0, 1)",
                [],
            )
            .unwrap();
            tx.execute(
                "INSERT INTO text_content (id, body) VALUES ('t', 'hello')",
                [],
            )
            .unwrap();
            tx.execute(
            "INSERT INTO artifact (id, type, schema_version, revision, content_store, content_id)
             VALUES ('a', 'text', 1, 1, 'sqlite', 't')",
            [],
        )
        .unwrap();
            tx.execute(
                "INSERT INTO canvas_node (id, canvas_id, kind, artifact_id, x, y, width, height)
             VALUES ('n', 'c', 'artifact', 'a', 0, 0, 100, 100)",
                [],
            )
            .unwrap();
            tx.commit().unwrap();
            drop(conn);

            let workspace = Workspace::open(Some(temp.path()), &id).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                header(&workspace.conn).unwrap(),
                (APPLICATION_ID, STORAGE_VERSION)
            );
            // Existing text and its placement survive the table rebuild.
            let body: String = workspace
                .conn
                .query_row("SELECT body FROM text_content WHERE id = 't'", [], |row| {
                    row.get(0)
                })
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(body, "hello");
            let purpose: String = workspace
                .conn
                .query_row(
                    "SELECT purpose FROM text_content WHERE id = 't'",
                    [],
                    |row| row.get(0),
                )
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(purpose, "note");
            let node_artifact: String = workspace
                .conn
                .query_row(
                    "SELECT artifact_id FROM canvas_node WHERE id = 'n'",
                    [],
                    |row| row.get(0),
                )
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(node_artifact, "a");
            // Drawing artifacts are accepted after the upgrade.
            workspace
                .conn
                .execute(
                    "INSERT INTO drawing_content (id, body) VALUES ('d', '{}')",
                    [],
                )
                .unwrap();
            workspace
            .conn
            .execute(
                "INSERT INTO artifact (id, type, schema_version, revision, content_store, content_id)
                 VALUES ('a2', 'drawing', 1, 1, 'sqlite', 'd')",
                [],
            )
            .unwrap();
        }
    }

/// `AGNT`: identifies Agentica workspace databases.

/// Ordered migrations; index + 1 is the resulting `user_version`.
const MIGRATIONS: &[&str] = &[
    include_str!("schema_v1.sql"),

    include_str!("schema_v3.sql"),

/// A runtime error reported to clients with a stable code.

    pub message: String,

}

        Self {

        }
    }
}

        )
    }
}

/// Open a connection with foreign keys and durable transaction commits.
fn connect(path: &Path, create: bool) -> rusqlite::Result<Connection> {
    let mut flags = OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_READ_WRITE | OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_NO_MUTEX;
    if create {
        flags |= OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_CREATE;
    }
    let conn = Connection::open_with_flags(path, flags)?;
    // Listing readers may briefly hold shared locks.
    conn.busy_timeout(Duration::from_secs(2))?;
    // Foreign keys stay off until migrations finish: storage rebuilds drop
    // parent tables, which SQLite rejects while they are enforced. `create`
    // and `open` re-enable them once the schema is current.
    conn.pragma_update(None, "foreign_keys", false)?;
    conn.pragma_update(None, "synchronous", "FULL")?;
    Ok(conn)
}

/// Apply `migrations[from..]` in the caller's transaction; the caller commits.
fn migrate(tx: &Transaction, from: i64, migrations: &[&str]) -> rusqlite::Result<()> {
    for sql in migrations.iter().skip(from as usize) {
        tx.execute_batch(sql)?;
    }
    if from == 0 {
        tx.pragma_update(None, "application_id", APPLICATION_ID)?;
    }
    tx.pragma_update(None, "user_version", migrations.len() as i64)
}

fn header(conn: &Connection) -> rusqlite::Result<(i64, i64)> {
    Ok((
        conn.pragma_query_value(None, "application_id", |row| row.get(0))?,
        conn.pragma_query_value(None, "user_version", |row| row.get(0))?,
    ))
}

/// An open workspace. Fields drop in order, so the connection closes before
/// the writer lock is released.
pub(crate) struct Workspace {
    pub id: String,
    pub conn: Connection,
    _lock: File,
}

impl Workspace {
    /// Create a workspace: schema and workspace row commit together.
    pub(crate) fn create(data_root: Option<&Path>, name: &str) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        let id = new_id()?;
        let dir = workspaces_dir(data_root)?.join(&id);
        fs::create_dir(&dir)?;
        let lock = lock_workspace(&dir, &id)?;
        let mut conn = connect(&dir.join(DATABASE_FILE), true)?;
        let tx = conn.transaction_with_behavior(TransactionBehavior::Immediate)?;
        migrate(&tx, 0, MIGRATIONS)?;
        tx.execute(
            "INSERT INTO workspace (id, name) VALUES (?1, ?2)",
            (&id, name),
        )?;
        tx.commit()?;
        conn.pragma_update(None, "foreign_keys", true)?;
        Ok(Self {
            id,
            conn,
            _lock: lock,
        })
    }

    /// Lock, validate, and migrate an existing workspace. Unsupported or
    /// incomplete storage is rejected before any change.
    pub(crate) fn open(data_root: Option<&Path>, id: &str) -> Result<Self, RuntimeError> {
        let dir = workspaces_dir(data_root)?.join(id);
        let database = dir.join(DATABASE_FILE);
        if !database.is_file() {
            return Err(RuntimeError::new("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found."));
        }
        let lock = lock_workspace(&dir, id)?;
        let mut conn = connect(&database, false)?;

            ));

        conn.pragma_update(None, "foreign_keys", true)?;
        Ok(Self {
            id: id.to_owned(),
            conn,
            _lock: lock,
        })
    }
}

/// Committed workspaces as `(id, name)`; `name` is `None` when the workspace
/// cannot be read by this build. Incomplete creations are skipped. Readers
/// never take the writer lock and never modify storage.
pub(crate) fn list_workspaces(
    data_root: Option<&Path>,
) -> Result<Vec<(String, Option<String>)>, RuntimeError> {
    let mut workspaces = Vec::new();
    for entry in fs::read_dir(workspaces_dir(data_root)?)? {
        let entry = entry?;
        let Some(id) = entry
            .file_name()
            .to_str()
            .filter(|id| is_id(id))
            .map(str::to_owned)
        else {
            continue;
        };
        let database = entry.path().join(DATABASE_FILE);
        if !database.is_file() {
            continue;
        }
        let read = || -> rusqlite::Result<Option<Option<String>>> {
            let conn = Connection::open_with_flags(
                &database,
                OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY | OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_NO_MUTEX,
            )?;
            conn.busy_timeout(Duration::from_secs(1))?;
            match header(&conn)? {
                (0, 0) => Ok(None),
                (APPLICATION_ID, 1..=STORAGE_VERSION) => Ok(Some(
                    conn.query_row("SELECT name FROM workspace WHERE id = ?1", [&id], |row| {
                        row.get(0)
                    })
                    .optional()?,
                )),
                _ => Ok(Some(None)),
            }
        };
        match read() {
            Ok(None) => {}
            Ok(Some(name)) => workspaces.push((id, name)),
            Err(_) => workspaces.push((id, None)),
        }
    }
    workspaces.sort();
    Ok(workspaces)
}

/// Delete a workspace's storage. The writer lock is held across the removal,
/// so the workspace must be closed in this and every other runtime. A directory
/// without a committed database is left alone: it is an interrupted creation,
/// not a workspace.
pub(crate) fn delete_workspace(data_root: Option<&Path>, id: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    let not_found = || RuntimeError::new("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found.");
    if !is_id(id) {
        return Err(not_found());
    }
    let dir = workspaces_dir(data_root)?.join(id);
    let database = dir.join(DATABASE_FILE);
    if !database.is_file() {
        return Err(not_found());
    }
    let lock = lock_workspace(&dir, id)?;
    let conn = Connection::open_with_flags(
        &database,
        OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY | OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_NO_MUTEX,
    )?;
    conn.busy_timeout(Duration::from_secs(1))?;
    match header(&conn)? {
        (0, 0) => return Err(not_found()),
        (APPLICATION_ID, 1..) => {}
        _ => {
            return Err(unsupported(
                "This file is not a committed Agentica workspace database.".to_owned(),
            ));
        }
    }
    let stored: Option<String> = conn
        .query_row("SELECT id FROM workspace", [], |row| row.get(0))
        .optional()?;

    fn workspace(&mut self, workspace_id: &str) -> Result<&mut Workspace, RuntimeError> {
        id("workspaceId", workspace_id)?;
        match &mut self.open {
            Some(open) if open.id == workspace_id => Ok(open),
            _ => Err(RuntimeError::new(
                "WORKSPACE_NOT_OPEN",
                "This workspace is not open in this runtime. Open it, then retry.",
            )),
        }
    }

    /// Run `apply` in one durable transaction; nothing is stored on error.
    fn transact(
        &mut self,
        workspace_id: &str,
        apply: impl FnOnce(&Transaction) -> Result<Value, RuntimeError>,
    ) -> Result<Value, RuntimeError> {
        let workspace = self.workspace(workspace_id)?;
        let tx = workspace
            .conn
            .transaction_with_behavior(TransactionBehavior::Immediate)?;
        let result = apply(&tx)?;
        tx.commit()?;
        Ok(result)
    }

    /// Workspaces this runtime can see, in stable order.
    fn workspaces(&self) -> Result<Vec<Value>, RuntimeError> {
        Ok(list_workspaces(self.data_root())?
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(id, name)| json!({ "id": id, "name": name }))
            .collect())
    }

    fn workspace_state(&mut self) -> Result<Value, RuntimeError> {
        let Some(workspace) = &self.open else {
            unreachable!("called after opening a workspace");
        };
        let conn = &workspace.conn;
        let name: String = conn.query_row("SELECT name FROM workspace", [], |row| row.get(0))?;
        Ok(json!({ "workspace": { "id": workspace.id, "name": name },
            "canvases": canvases(conn)? }))
    }

/// Canvas titles in stable order, as the picker lists them.
fn canvases(conn: &Connection) -> Result<Vec<Value>, RuntimeError> {
    let mut statement = conn.prepare("SELECT id, title FROM canvas ORDER BY rowid")?;
    let rows = statement.query_map([], |row| {
        Ok(json!({ "id": row.get::<_, String>(0)?, "title": row.get::<_, String>(1)? }))
    })?;
    let canvases = rows.collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
    Ok(canvases)
}

fn canvas_revision(tx: &Transaction, canvas_id: &str) -> Result<i64, RuntimeError> {
    tx.query_row(
        "SELECT revision FROM canvas WHERE id = ?1",
        [canvas_id],
        |row| row.get(0),
    )
    .optional()?
    .ok_or_else(|| not_found("Canvas"))
}

fn check_canvas(tx: &Transaction, canvas_id: &str, expected: i64) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
    let current = canvas_revision(tx, canvas_id)?;
    if current == expected {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(conflict("canvas", current))
    }
}

fn bump(tx: &Transaction, canvas_id: &str, expected: i64) -> Result<i64, RuntimeError> {
    tx.execute(
        "UPDATE canvas SET revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = ?1",
        [canvas_id],
    )?;
    Ok(expected + 1)
}

#[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "camelCase")]
enum Shape {
    Path(PathShape),
    Rectangle(BoxShape),
    Ellipse(BoxShape),
}

impl Shape {
    fn check(&self) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        match self {
            Shape::Path(path) => {
                if path.points.is_empty() || path.points.len() > MAX_POINTS {
                    return Err(invalid(format!("A path needs 1 to {MAX_POINTS} points.")));
                }
                for [x, y] in &path.points {
                    in_range("points", *x, -MAX_COORDINATE, MAX_COORDINATE)?;
                    in_range("points", *y, -MAX_COORDINATE, MAX_COORDINATE)?;
                }
                in_range("width", path.width, 1.0, MAX_STROKE_WIDTH)?;
                color(&path.color)
            }
            Shape::Rectangle(box_shape) | Shape::Ellipse(box_shape) => {
                if box_shape.label.encode_utf16().count() > MAX_LABEL {
                    return Err(invalid("Shape label must not exceed 120 characters."));
                }
                in_range("x", box_shape.x, -MAX_COORDINATE, MAX_COORDINATE)?;
                in_range("y", box_shape.y, -MAX_COORDINATE, MAX_COORDINATE)?;
                in_range("width", box_shape.width, f64::MIN_POSITIVE, MAX_COORDINATE)?;
                in_range(
                    "height",
                    box_shape.height,
                    f64::MIN_POSITIVE,
                    MAX_COORDINATE,
                )?;
                color(&box_shape.color)
            }
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase", deny_unknown_fields)]
struct Drawing {
    shapes: Vec<Shape>,
}

impl Drawing {
    fn check(&self) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        if self.shapes.is_empty() || self.shapes.len() > MAX_SHAPES {
            return Err(invalid(format!(
                "A drawing needs 1 to {MAX_SHAPES} shapes."
            )));
        }
        self.shapes.iter().try_for_each(Shape::check)
    }
}

// Check only touched objects: unrelated manual work must not invalidate a proposal.
fn scoped_node(
    tx: &Transaction,
    canvas_id: &str,
    node_id: &str,
    context: &Value,
    created: &HashSet<String>,
    checked: &mut HashSet<String>,
) -> Result<Value, RuntimeError> {
    id("nodeId", node_id)?;
    let current = canvas_state(tx, canvas_id)?;
    let node = current["nodes"]
        .as_array()
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .find(|n| n["id"] == node_id)
        .ok_or_else(|| not_found("Proposal target"))?;
    if !created.contains(node_id) && !checked.contains(node_id) {
        let original = context["nodes"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .find(|n| n["id"] == node_id)
            .ok_or_else(|| {
                RuntimeError::new(
                    "SCOPE_DENIED",
                    "The proposal targets an object outside this turn's context.",
                )
            })?;
        let original_artifact = context["artifacts"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .find(|a| a["id"] == original["artifactId"])
            .unwrap();
        let current_artifact = current["artifacts"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .find(|a| a["id"] == node["artifactId"])
            .unwrap();
        if node != original || current_artifact["revision"] != original_artifact["revision"] {
            return Err(RuntimeError::new("CONFLICT", "A proposal target changed. Discard this proposal and regenerate from current content; nothing was applied."));
        }
        // Editing a shared artifact must not change placements outside the captured scope.
        let mut stmt = tx.prepare("SELECT id FROM canvas_node WHERE artifact_id = ?1")?;
        let refs = stmt
            .query_map([node["artifactId"].as_str().unwrap()], |r| {
                r.get::<_, String>(0)
            })?
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
        if refs.iter().any(|id| {
            !context["nodes"]
                .as_array()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .any(|n| n["id"] == *id)
        }) {
            return Err(RuntimeError::new(
                "SCOPE_DENIED",
                "This artifact has placements outside the turn's context.",
            ));
        }
        checked.insert(node_id.to_owned());
    }
    Ok(node.clone())
}

fn canvas_state(tx: &Transaction, canvas_id: &str) -> Result<Value, RuntimeError> {
    let canvas = tx
        .query_row(
            "SELECT title, revision, viewport_x, viewport_y, viewport_zoom FROM canvas WHERE id = ?1",
            [canvas_id],
            |row| {
                Ok(json!({
                    "id": canvas_id,
                    "title": row.get::<_, String>(0)?,
                    "revision": row.get::<_, i64>(1)?,
                    "viewport": {
                        "x": row.get::<_, f64>(2)?,
                        "y": row.get::<_, f64>(3)?,
                        "zoom": row.get::<_, f64>(4)?,
                    },
                }))
            },
        )
        .optional()?
        .ok_or_else(|| not_found("Canvas"))?;
    let mut statement = tx.prepare(
        "SELECT id, artifact_id, x, y, width, height FROM canvas_node
         WHERE canvas_id = ?1 ORDER BY rowid",
    )?;
    let nodes = statement
        .query_map([canvas_id], |row| {
            Ok(json!({
                "id": row.get::<_, String>(0)?,
                "artifactId": row.get::<_, String>(1)?,
                "x": row.get::<_, f64>(2)?,
                "y": row.get::<_, f64>(3)?,
                "width": row.get::<_, f64>(4)?,
                "height": row.get::<_, f64>(5)?,
            }))
        })?
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
    let mut statement = tx.prepare(
        "SELECT id, source_node_id, target_node_id FROM canvas_edge
         WHERE canvas_id = ?1 ORDER BY rowid",
    )?;
    let edges = statement
        .query_map([canvas_id], |row| {
            Ok(json!({
                "id": row.get::<_, String>(0)?,
                "kind": "relationship",
                "sourceNodeId": row.get::<_, String>(1)?,
                "targetNodeId": row.get::<_, String>(2)?,
            }))
        })?
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
    let mut statement = tx.prepare(
        "SELECT artifact_id FROM canvas_node WHERE canvas_id = ?1
         GROUP BY artifact_id ORDER BY min(rowid)",
    )?;
    let artifact_ids = statement
        .query_map([canvas_id], |row| row.get::<_, String>(0))?
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
    let artifacts = artifact_ids
        .iter()
        .map(|artifact_id| artifact(tx, artifact_id))
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
    let (groups, tiles) = projects::collections(tx, canvas_id)?;
    Ok(
        json!({ "canvas": canvas, "nodes": nodes, "edges": edges, "artifacts": artifacts,
        "projectGroups": groups, "sessionTiles": tiles }),
    )
}

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    tauri_build::try_build(tauri_build::Attributes::new().app_manifest(
        tauri_build::AppManifest::new().commands(&[
            "runtime_request",
            "session_request",
            "session_subscribe",
            "session_shutdown",
        ]),
    ))?;
    Ok(())
}

      "devCsp": "default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:1420 ws://127.0.0.1:1420 https: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*"

    "icon": ["icons/icon.png", "icons/icon.ico"]
  }

```

> _Reasoning_
> CSP: `img-src 'self' data:` — blob URLs? For images rendered via blob URL, `img-src` does not include `blob:`. Need to add `blob:` to img-src in tauri.conf.json and http.rs CSP. Also for PDF worker (`worker-src`) default-src 'self' — module worker loaded from self is allowed? Worker script from 'self' should be allowed by default-src. Docx iframe srcDoc: `frame-src` default-src 'self' may block srcdoc? srcdoc frames inherit? The design node already uses sandboxed iframe with srcdoc, so it works. Check DesignNode for CSP patterns.
> 
> Mammoth HTML string in iframe srcDoc; styles from mammoth are inline styles. Need CSS inserted.
> 
> PDF canvas rendering uses blob? No, draws to canvas. Fine. Worker via URL from self.
> 
> Images as blob URLs require CSP update; alternatively convert to data URL (base64) — `img-src data:` already allowed, and simpler (no object URL cleanup). For an 8MB file data URL ~10.7MB, still ok. Use data URL and avoid CSP change? `URL.createObjectURL` is more memory efficient. But CSP modification is easy. Note http.rs CSP also needs `blob:` for browser mode; tauri.conf for desktop. Add `img-src 'self' data: blob:` and maybe `frame-src 'self' blob:`? Not needed if using srcDoc.
> 
> For PDF preview we use canvas; no blob. For opening/download, blob URL download doesn't require CSP. For docx, srcDoc.
> 
> Now, Tauri file picker `<input type=file>` works. No drag-drop needed? "Preview nodes on the canvas" — file picker via toolbar button is a fine first implementation; drag&drop from OS would be nice. Tauri webview supports HTML5 drag-drop of files? In Tauri v2, dragging files into the window triggers a native drag-drop event; HTML dnd may be blocked by default on Windows (dragDropEnabled true intercepts). Implementing JS drop would require disabling `dragDropEnabled` in window config (which affects native events) or listening to Tauri events with paths and reading via fs. To avoid complexity, implement the file picker button, and maybe standard browser drop in browser mode. Since user didn't specify drag-drop, a picker is sufficient. I'll add an "Add file" button in the toolbar.
> 
> Let me inspect CanvasToolbar and App's layout to insert a file input/button.

- path: apps\desktop\src\lib\components\CanvasToolbar.svelte
  content: |
      <script lang="ts">
        import Icon from "./Icon.svelte";
        import {
          ACTION_TOOLS,
          PRIMARY_TOOLS,
          STROKE_COLORS,
          STROKE_WIDTHS,
          type Tool,
        } from "../tools";
      
        interface Props {
          tool: Tool;
          color: string;
          width: number;
          onSelect: (tool: Tool) => void;
          onColor: (color: string) => void;
          onWidth: (width: number) => void;
        }
      
        let { tool, color, width, onSelect, onColor, onWidth }: Props = $props();
      </script>
      
      <div class="toolbar" role="toolbar" aria-label="Canvas tools">
        <div class="toolbar__card" role="group" aria-label="Action tools">
          {#each PRIMARY_TOOLS as item (item.tool)}
            <button
              class="toolbar__btn"
              class:toolbar__btn--active={tool === item.tool}
              type="button"
              title={`${item.label} (${item.key}) — ${item.hint}`}
              aria-label={item.label}
              aria-pressed={tool === item.tool}
              onclick={() => onSelect(item.tool)}
            >
              <Icon name={item.icon} size={20} />
            </button>
          {/each}
          {#each ACTION_TOOLS as item (item.tool)}
            <button
              class="toolbar__btn"
              class:toolbar__btn--active={tool === item.tool}
              type="button"
              title={`${item.label} (${item.key}) — ${item.hint}`}
              aria-label={item.label}
              aria-pressed={tool === item.tool}
              onclick={() => onSelect(item.tool)}
            >
              <Icon name={item.icon} size={20} />
            </button>
          {/each}
        </div>
      
        {#if tool === "draw"}
          <div class="toolbar__card toolbar__card--options">
            <div class="toolbar__option">
              <span class="toolbar__label">Color</span>
              <div class="toolbar__group" role="group" aria-label="Stroke color">
                {#each STROKE_COLORS as swatch (swatch)}
                  <button
                    class="toolbar__swatch"
                    class:toolbar__swatch--active={color === swatch}
                    type="button"
                    title={`Stroke color ${swatch}`}
                    aria-label={`Stroke color ${swatch}`}
                    aria-pressed={color === swatch}
                    style:background={swatch}
                    onclick={() => onColor(swatch)}
                  ></button>
                {/each}
              </div>
            </div>
      
            <div class="toolbar__option">
              <span class="toolbar__label">Size</span>
              <div class="toolbar__group" role="group" aria-label="Stroke width">
                {#each STROKE_WIDTHS as option (option)}
                  <button
                    class="toolbar__width"
                    class:toolbar__width--active={width === option}
                    type="button"
                    title={`Stroke width ${option}px`}
                    aria-label={`Stroke width ${option}px`}
                    aria-pressed={width === option}
                    onclick={() => onWidth(option)}
                  >
                    <span
                      class="toolbar__dot"
                      style:width={`${option}px`}
                      style:height={`${option}px`}
                    ></span>
                  </button>
                {/each}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        {/if}
      </div>

  content: |
      <script lang="ts">
        import Icon from "./Icon.svelte";
      
        interface NodeItem {
          id: string;
          label: string;
          kind: string;
        }
      
        interface Props {
          items: NodeItem[];
          selectedId: string;
          busy: boolean;
          width: number;
          onSelect: (id: string) => void;
          onClose: () => void;
          onResize: (width: number) => void;
          onDelete: (id: string) => void;
        }
      
        let {
          items,
          selectedId,
          busy,
          width,
          onSelect,
          onClose,
          onResize,
          onDelete,
        }: Props = $props();
      
        const ICONS: Record<string, string> = {
          project: "folder_open",
          shell: "terminal",
          "cli-agent": "smart_toy",
          instruction: "note_add",
          text: "text_fields",
          path: "gesture",
          rectangle: "crop_square",
          ellipse: "circle",
        };
      
        const KINDS: Record<string, string> = {
          project: "Project",
          shell: "Terminal",
          "cli-agent": "Codex",
          instruction: "Instruction note",
          text: "Text",
          path: "Drawing",
          rectangle: "Rectangle",
          ellipse: "Ellipse",
        };
      
        /** Drag the right edge to change the drawer width. */
        function startResize(event: PointerEvent) {
          if (event.button !== 0) return;
          event.preventDefault();
          const grip = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
          const startX = event.clientX;
          const startWidth = width;
          grip.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
          const move = (moveEvent: PointerEvent) =>
            onResize(startWidth + (moveEvent.clientX - startX));
          const end = () => {
            grip.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
            grip.removeEventListener("pointerup", end);
            grip.removeEventListener("pointercancel", end);
          };
          grip.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
          grip.addEventListener("pointerup", end);
          grip.addEventListener("pointercancel", end);
        }
      
        /** Resize from the keyboard too: arrows nudge, shift arrows jump. */
        function resizeByKey(event: KeyboardEvent) {
          const step = event.shiftKey ? 32 : 8;
          if (event.key === "ArrowRight") onResize(width + step);
          else if (event.key === "ArrowLeft") onResize(width - step);
          else return;
          event.preventDefault();
        }
      </script>
      
      <aside class="drawer" style="--drawer-w: {width}px" aria-label="Nodes">
        <div class="drawer__head">
          <h2><Icon name="toc" size={18} />Nodes</h2>
          <span class="drawer__count">{items.length}</span>
          <button
            class="icon-btn"
            type="button"
            title="Hide nodes"
            aria-label="Hide nodes"
            onclick={onClose}
          >
            <Icon name="close" size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>
      
        <div class="drawer__scroll">
          {#if items.length === 0}
            <div class="drawer__empty">
              <Icon name="layers" size={26} />
              <p>No nodes yet</p>
              <small>Text and drawings you add appear here.</small>
            </div>
          {:else}
            <ul class="drawer__list">
              {#each items as item (item.id)}
                <li class="drawer__row">
                  <button
                    class="drawer__item"
                    class:drawer__item--active={item.id === selectedId}
                    type="button"
                    disabled={busy}
                    title={item.label}
                    aria-pressed={item.id === selectedId}
                    onclick={() => onSelect(item.id)}
                  >
                    <span class="drawer__icon"
                      ><Icon name={ICONS[item.kind] ?? "gesture"} size={18} /></span
                    >
                    <span class="drawer__text">
                      <strong>{item.label}</strong>
                      <small>{KINDS[item.kind] ?? "Node"}</small>
                    </span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    class="icon-btn drawer__delete"
                    type="button"
                    title={`Delete ${item.label}`}
                    aria-label={`Delete ${item.label}`}
                    disabled={busy}
                    onclick={() => onDelete(item.id)}
                  >
                    <Icon name="delete" size={16} />
                  </button>
                </li>
              {/each}
            </ul>
          {/if}
        </div>
      
        <button
          class="drawer__grip"
          type="button"
          aria-label="Resize nodes panel"
          title="Drag to resize"
          onpointerdown={startResize}
          onkeydown={resizeByKey}
        ></button>
      </aside>

  "content": "-- Files are copied into the workspace so a canvas survives the original moving\n-- away. Bytes live in file_content and never enter canvas context; only the\n-- extracted text is shared with the agent. An upload is staged in file_upload\n-- through bounded chunks and becomes an artifact only when it finishes.\nCREATE TABLE file_content (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    body BLOB NOT NULL,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),\n    mime TEXT NOT NULL,\n    size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size BETWEEN 0 AND 8388608),\n    text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\n) STRICT;\n\nCREATE TABLE file_upload (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    canvas_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES canvas (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    mime TEXT NOT NULL,\n    size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size BETWEEN 0 AND 8388608),\n    text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body BLOB NOT NULL DEFAULT X'',\n    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL\n) STRICT;\n\nCREATE INDEX file_upload_canvas ON file_upload (canvas_id);\n\n-- SQLite cannot change a CHECK constraint in place, so rebuild the artifact\n-- table and copy every row to accept the new type.\nCREATE TABLE artifact_v7 (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('text', 'drawing', 'html', 'file')),\n    schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version = 1),\n    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 1),\n    content_store TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (content_store = 'sqlite'),\n    content_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE\n) STRICT;\n\nINSERT INTO artifact_v7 (id, type, schema_version, revision, content_store, content_id)\n    SELECT id, type, schema_version, revision, content_store, content_id FROM artifact;\n\nDROP TABLE artifact;\nALTER TABLE artifact_v7 RENAME TO artifact;\n"
}

    canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null;

    canvasContext?: CanvasRenderingContext2D | undefined;
    /**

<script lang="ts">
  import { untrack } from "svelte";
  import { LIMITS } from "@agentica/protocol";
  import Modal from "./Modal.svelte";
  import Markdown from "./Markdown.svelte";

  interface Props {
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
    /** Current source; editing reports every change through `onEdit`. */
    text: string;
    /** Labels render as plain text; text artifacts use the Markdown subset. */
    markdown?: boolean;
    /** Present only for editable text; labels and proposals are read-only. */
    onEdit?: (text: string) => void;
    editDisabled?: boolean;
    startEditing?: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
  }
  let {
    title,
    subtitle,
    text,
    markdown = true,
    onEdit,
    editDisabled = false,
    startEditing = false,
    onClose,
  }: Props = $props();

  // Opening mode is chosen once; later busy states only disable the editor.
  let editing = $state(untrack(() => startEditing && !!onEdit));
  let closeButton = $state<HTMLButtonElement>();
  let textarea = $state<HTMLTextAreaElement>();

  // The dialog's own autofocus lands on the first control; move it to the
  // most useful one once rendered.
  $effect(() => {
    const target = editing ? textarea : closeButton;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => target?.focus());
  });
</script>

<Modal {title} {subtitle} icon="article" wide {onClose}>
  {#snippet actions()}
    {#if onEdit}
      <button
        class="btn btn--soft"
        type="button"
        aria-pressed={editing}
        disabled={editDisabled && !editing}
        onclick={() => (editing = !editing)}
        >{editing ? "Done editing" : "Edit source"}</button
      >
    {/if}
    <button
      bind:this={closeButton}
      class="btn btn--ghost"
      type="button"
      onclick={onClose}>Close</button
    >
  {/snippet}
  {#if editing && onEdit}
    <label class="sr-only" for="reader-source">Source text</label>
    <textarea
      id="reader-source"
      bind:this={textarea}
      class="reader__source"
      value={text}
      maxlength={LIMITS.text}
      disabled={editDisabled}
      oninput={(event) => onEdit?.(event.currentTarget.value)}></textarea>
  {:else}
    <div class="reader__content" tabindex="-1">
      {#if !text.trim()}
        <p class="muted">This object has no text yet.</p>
      {:else if markdown}
        <Markdown source={text} links />
      {:else}
        <p class="reader__plain">{text}</p>
      {/if}
    </div>
  {/if}
</Modal>

  /**
   * The unobscured canvas region in canvas-element pixels, measured from the
   * overlays actually rendered now (composer, review, tools, navigation, and
   * any panel drawn over the canvas).
   */
  function usable(): Box | undefined {
    if (!canvasEl) return undefined;
    const rect = canvasEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return undefined;
    const obstacles = [
      ...canvasEl.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
        ".canvas-dock > *, .canvas-nav, .canvas__nodes, .canvas__inspector",
      ),
      ...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".drawer, .inspector"),
    ].map((element) => element.getBoundingClientRect());
    return usableArea(
      { width: rect.width, height: rect.height },
      overlayInsets(rect, obstacles),
    );
  }

  /** Navigation changes only the viewport; object geometry is never written. */
  function setView(next: Viewport) {
    if (!editorState.document) return;
    viewport = next;
    editor.setViewport(next);
  }

> _Reasoning_
> Rust tests pass. But we need tests for new functionality, especially integration: file.begin/chunk/finish/read, migration v7, schema validation, editor upload.
> 
> Before tests, verify App UI behaviors and fix issues:
> 1. `nodeItems` name chain syntax - check passed svelte-check so okay.
> 2. File artifact rendering in preview proposals: agent cannot create files, but a pending proposal could move a file node; preview node for existing file uses same load. Fine.
> 3. `asNode` applied to file artifact with `onOpen` and later explicit `onResize` etc. fine.
> 4. FileNode `data.text` is extracted text; for image empty. PDF extraction may be empty for scanned PDFs; Reader says no text.
> 
> 5. `canvas.save` layout includes file nodes: yes nodes list includes all; `savedArtifacts` includes file content; content() works.
> 
> 6. Dirty tracking after `file.finish` -> `load` resets savedArtifacts. Good.
> 
> 7. `addFile` triggers `this.mutation` which refuses if `this.state.busy || saving`. Called after settleSave; busy false. Good. But `mutation` doesn't prevent `dirty` from live edits; `addFile` is queued, but if user edits during upload, those edits are published in `document` captured at start and `this.load` after finish uses the stale captured document! Indeed inside addFile I use `document` captured before async chunks, then `this.load({...document,...})` after finish, which discards any edits made mid-upload (busy blocks editing? `busy` true disables editing? `canEdit` uses `working`, and editor state busy probably blocks TextNode editable etc. But autosave maybe). `busy` true during upload; text editing disabled? TextNode `editable` = connected && !busy via asNode computed at effect rerun; likely yes. Fine.
> 
> 8. FileNode `$effect` dependency `data.load`: data object is recreated each render? asNode creates new data and `load` function every time nodes recompute (on any state change), so effect reruns and destroys/reloads PDF. Svelte `$effect` tracks `data.load` reference; if recreated, reloads on every node list update. That's bad for PDFs and causes flicker. The whole nodes array is rebuilt in `$effect` whenever editorState changes (every save/viewport change). SvelteFlow may update node data but effects in component re-run when prop changes. `data.load` identity changes each rebuild → reload. Need stable caching and avoid effect dependency on function identity.
> 
> Options: make FileNode load keyed only by artifact id, using untrack for load. Or make `load` stable via module cache: `readCanvasFile` already caches by ids, so re-invoking returns same promise, but effect still re-runs loading state and for PDF creates a new openPdf/render. Better change effect deps to `data.name`/`kind` only and `untrack(() => data.load)`. Import untrack from svelte; use in effect:
> ```ts
> $effect(() => {
>   const current = kind;
>   void data.name;
>   const load = untrack(() => data.load);
>   ...
> });
> ```
> This way effect runs when kind/name changes only (initial). Cleanup on destroy. Good.
> 
> 9. Viewport changes trigger asNode rebuild and FileNode props updates; effect won't rerun with untrack. Good.
> 
> 10. PDF ResizeObserver effect depends on frame/kind only, good; it calls renderPage which reads current pdf.
> 
> 11. Loading image data URL for a large image (8MB → 10.7MB string) in `img` may be heavy but okay.
> 
> 12. `onOpen` in data overwritten? The explicit data object later includes no onOpen, so spread persists.
> 
> 13. `data.onRead` for file set in explicit later, fine.
> 
> 14. Import via toolbar while toolbar closed: toolbarOpen default? Search. If false, no Add file button. There's "Add text" elsewhere. Need file importing accessible regardless. Add an "Add file" button in the top bar or empty state. Maybe add in empty canvas state and next to "Add text" button at line ~2049. Find the UI around 2049.

<script lang="ts">
  import { LIMITS } from "@agentica/protocol";
  import Icon from "./Icon.svelte";

  interface Props {
    placeholder?: string;
    toolbarOpen: boolean;
    loading?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    onToggleToolbar: () => void;
    onSubmit?: (prompt: string) => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
    /** Short scope line, such as "2 selected objects · recent conversation". */
    scope?: string;
    /** Provider name and model shown in the disclosure. */
    provider?: string;
    /** What the next request actually transmits. */
    details?: string[];
    notice?: string;
    /** Live generation counters, such as "Request 2 of 8 · 1 edit staged". */
    progress?: string;
    onCancel?: () => void;
  }

  let {
    placeholder = "Ask anything, or describe what you want to add…",
    toolbarOpen,
    loading = false,
    disabled = false,
    onToggleToolbar,
    onSubmit,
    scope = "",
    provider = "",
    details = [],
    notice = "",
    progress = "",
    onCancel,
  }: Props = $props();

  let promptText = $state("");
  let detailsOpen = $state(false);

  async function submit() {
    const submittedText = promptText;
    const trimmed = promptText.trim();
    if (!trimmed || loading || disabled) return;
    if ((await onSubmit?.(trimmed)) && promptText === submittedText) {
      promptText = "";
    }
  }

  function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey && !event.isComposing) {
      event.preventDefault();
      void submit();
    }
  }
</script>

</div>

      import { invoke } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
      import { callRuntime, desktopMode } from "./runtime";
      
      /**
       * Canvas file helpers. Files are copied into workspace storage in bounded
       * chunks; only extracted text is part of canvas context. Previews are loaded on
       * demand so opening a canvas with a large PDF does not read every byte.
       */
      
      const MIME_BY_TYPE: Record<string, FileMime> = {
        "image/png": "image/png",
        "image/jpeg": "image/jpeg",
        "image/jpg": "image/jpeg",
        "image/webp": "image/webp",
        "image/gif": "image/gif",
        "image/svg+xml": "image/svg+xml",
        "application/pdf": "application/pdf",

          "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
        "application/msword": "application/msword",
        "text/plain": "text/plain",
        "text/markdown": "text/markdown",
        "text/csv": "text/csv",
      };
      
      const MIME_BY_EXTENSION: Record<string, FileMime> = {
        png: "image/png",
        jpg: "image/jpeg",
        jpeg: "image/jpeg",
        webp: "image/webp",
        gif: "image/gif",
        svg: "image/svg+xml",
        pdf: "application/pdf",
        docx: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
        doc: "application/msword",
        txt: "text/plain",
        md: "text/markdown",
        markdown: "text/markdown",
        csv: "text/csv",
      };
      
      /** `accept` for the file picker; one list keeps picker and validation aligned. */
      export const FILE_ACCEPT = [
        ...Object.keys(MIME_BY_EXTENSION).map((extension) => `.${extension}`),
        ...Object.keys(MIME_BY_TYPE).filter((mime) => mime !== "image/jpg"),
      ].join(",");
      
      export type FileKind = "image" | "pdf" | "docx" | "doc" | "text";
      
      /** Normalize a browser-reported type, falling back to the filename extension. */
      export function fileMime(file: { name: string; type?: string }): FileMime | undefined {
        const reported = MIME_BY_TYPE[file.type?.toLowerCase() ?? ""];
        if (reported) return reported;
        const extension = file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
        return MIME_BY_EXTENSION[extension];
      }
      
      export function fileKind(mime: string): FileKind {
        if (mime.startsWith("image/")) return "image";
        if (mime === "application/pdf") return "pdf";
        if (mime === "application/msword") return "doc";
        if (mime.includes("wordprocessingml")) return "docx";
        return "text";
      }
      
      export function fileKindLabel(mime: string): string {
        switch (fileKind(mime)) {
          case "image":
            return "Image";
          case "pdf":
            return "PDF";
          case "docx":
            return "Word document";
          case "doc":
            return "Word document";
          default:
            return "Text file";
        }
      }
      
      export function formatFileSize(bytes: number): string {
        if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
        if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(bytes < 10 * 1024 ? 1 : 0)} KB`;
        return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
      }
      
      /** Base64 without spreading a large file onto the call stack. */
      export function bytesToBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
        let binary = "";
        for (let index = 0; index < bytes.length; index += 0x8000) {
          binary += String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(index, index + 0x8000));
        }
        return btoa(binary);
      }
      
      export function base64ToBytes(data: string): Uint8Array {
        const binary = atob(data);
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
        for (let index = 0; index < binary.length; index += 1)
          bytes[index] = binary.charCodeAt(index);
        return bytes;
      }
      
      /** A contiguous ArrayBuffer for Blob, PDF.js, and mammoth. */
      export function toArrayBuffer(bytes: Uint8Array): ArrayBuffer {
        return bytes.buffer.slice(
          bytes.byteOffset,
          bytes.byteOffset + bytes.byteLength,
        ) as ArrayBuffer;
      }
      
      export interface LoadedFile {
        name: string;
        mime: FileMime;
        size: number;
        data: string;
      }
      
      const loaded = new Map<string, Promise<LoadedFile>>();
      
      /** File bytes never change for an artifact, so previews share one read. */
      export function readCanvasFile(
        connectionKey: string,
        workspaceId: string,
        artifactId: string,
      ): Promise<LoadedFile> {
        const cacheKey = `${workspaceId}:${artifactId}`;
        const existing = loaded.get(cacheKey);
        if (existing) return existing;
        const request = callRuntime(connectionKey, false, "file.read", {
          workspaceId,
          artifactId,
        }).then(({ name, mime, size, data }) => ({ name, mime, size, data }));
        loaded.set(cacheKey, request);
        request.catch(() => loaded.delete(cacheKey));
        return request;
      }
      
      /** Open with the OS application on desktop, or save a copy in a browser. */
      export async function openCanvasFile(
        connectionKey: string,
        workspaceId: string,
        artifactId: string,
      ) {
        if (desktopMode) {
          await invoke("open_file", { workspaceId, artifactId });
          return;
        }
        const file = await readCanvasFile(connectionKey, workspaceId, artifactId);
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(
          new Blob([toArrayBuffer(base64ToBytes(file.data))], { type: file.mime }),
        );
        const anchor = document.createElement("a");
        anchor.href = url;
        anchor.download = file.name;
        anchor.click();
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10_000);
      }
      
      /** Text shared with the agent and shown by Read; bounded by the protocol. */
      export async function extractFileText(
        file: File,
        mime: FileMime,
      ): Promise<string> {
        const kind = fileKind(mime);
        if (kind === "image" || kind === "doc") return "";
        try {
          if (kind === "text") {
            return (await file.text()).slice(0, FILE_LIMITS.text).trim();
          }
          if (kind === "pdf") {
            return (
              await pdfText(new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()))
            ).slice(0, FILE_LIMITS.text).trim();
          }
          const mammoth = await loadMammoth();
          const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({
            arrayBuffer: await file.arrayBuffer(),
          });
          return result.value.slice(0, FILE_LIMITS.text).trim();
        } catch {
          // A preview can still open; extraction must not block the import.
          return "";
        }
      }
      
      interface Mammoth {
        extractRawText(input: { arrayBuffer: ArrayBuffer }): Promise<{ value: string }>;
        convertToHtml(input: { arrayBuffer: ArrayBuffer }): Promise<{ value: string }>;
      }
      
      async function loadMammoth(): Promise<Mammoth> {
        const module = await import("mammoth");
        return ((module as unknown as { default?: Mammoth }).default ??
          module) as unknown as Mammoth;
      }
      
      /** Renderable Word HTML for the preview frame; scripts stay blocked there. */
      export async function docxHtml(bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<string> {
        const mammoth = await loadMammoth();
        const result = await mammoth.convertToHtml({
          arrayBuffer: toArrayBuffer(bytes),
        });
        return result.value;
      }
      
      let pdfWorker: Promise<void> | undefined;
      
      async function loadPdfJs() {
        const pdfjs = await import("pdfjs-dist");
        pdfWorker ??= import("pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url").then(
          (worker) => {
            pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = worker.default;
          },
        );
        await pdfWorker;
        return pdfjs;
      }
      
      export async function openPdf(bytes: Uint8Array) {
        const pdfjs = await loadPdfJs();
        const task = pdfjs.getDocument({ data: toArrayBuffer(bytes) });
        const pdf = await task.promise;
        return { pdf, destroy: () => task.destroy() };
      }
      
      async function pdfText(bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<string> {
        const document = await openPdf(bytes);
        const pdf = document.pdf;
        let text = "";
        try {
          for (
            let pageNumber = 1;
            pageNumber <= pdf.numPages && text.length < FILE_LIMITS.text;
            pageNumber += 1
          ) {
            const page = await pdf.getPage(pageNumber);
            const content = await page.getTextContent();
            for (const item of content.items) {
              if (!("str" in item)) continue;
              text += item.str;
              text += item.hasEOL ? "\n" : " ";
            }
            text += "\n";
          }
        } finally {
          await document.destroy();
        }
        return text;
      }

//! Desktop-transport contract tests and mixed-mode writer contention with the
//! real detached executable. tests/http.test.mjs runs the same fixture over HTTP.

use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    io::{BufRead, BufReader, Read, Write},
    net::TcpStream,
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    process::{Child, Command, Stdio},
};

use agentica_runtime::{DesktopBackend, Runtime};
use serde_json::{json, Value};

fn substitute(value: &Value, saved: &HashMap<String, Value>) -> Value {
    match value {
        Value::String(text) if text.starts_with('$') => saved
            .get(&text[1..])
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("fixture value {text} was not saved"))
            .clone(),
        Value::Array(items) => items.iter().map(|item| substitute(item, saved)).collect(),
        Value::Object(fields) => Value::Object(
            fields
                .iter()
                .map(|(key, item)| (key.clone(), substitute(item, saved)))
                .collect(),
        ),
        other => other.clone(),
    }
}

/// Objects match a subset of keys; arrays and scalars match exactly.
fn matches(expected: &Value, actual: &Value) -> bool {
    match (expected, actual) {
        (Value::Object(expected), Value::Object(actual)) => expected
            .iter()
            .all(|(key, value)| actual.get(key).is_some_and(|item| matches(value, item))),
        (Value::Array(expected), Value::Array(actual)) => {
            expected.len() == actual.len()
                && expected.iter().zip(actual).all(|(e, a)| matches(e, a))
        }
        (Value::Number(expected), Value::Number(actual)) => expected.as_f64() == actual.as_f64(),
        _ => expected == actual,
    }
}

fn rpc(id: &str, method: &str, params: Value) -> Value {
    json!({ "protocolVersion": 1, "id": id, "method": method, "params": params })
}

fn desktop(root: &Path) -> DesktopBackend {
    let mut backend = DesktopBackend::new(Runtime::new(Some(root.to_path_buf())));
    let ping = json!({ "protocolVersion": 1, "id": "connect", "method": "runtime.ping" });
    backend.request(&ping, true).unwrap();
    backend
}

fn call(backend: &mut DesktopBackend, method: &str, params: Value) -> Value {
    backend
        .request(&rpc("desktop", method, params), false)
        .unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn shared_fixture_round_trips_through_the_desktop_transport() {
    let temp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let fixture: Value = serde_json::from_str(include_str!(
        "../../../tests/fixtures/workspace-roundtrip.json"
    ))

> Replace begin insert, chunk query/insert, finish body assembly.
> 
> Begin:
> ```sql
> INSERT INTO file_upload (id, canvas_id, name, mime, size, text, created_at) VALUES (...)
> ```
> 
> Chunk:
> ```rust
> let size: i64 = ... SELECT size...
> let received: i64 = tx.query_row("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(length(body)), 0) FROM file_chunk WHERE upload_id = ?1", ...)?;
> if offset != received ...
> tx.execute("INSERT INTO file_chunk (upload_id, offset, body) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)", (&upload_id, offset as i64, chunk.as_slice()))?;
> ```
> Also ensure no duplicate offset; PK handles.
> 
> Finish:
> - SELECT canvas_id,name,mime,size,text (no body).
> - received sum; if != size -> incomplete.
> - read chunks:
> ```rust
> let mut stmt = tx.prepare("SELECT body FROM file_chunk WHERE upload_id = ?1 ORDER BY offset")?;
> let chunks = stmt.query_map([...], |row| row.get::<_, Vec<u8>>(0))?.collect::<Result<Vec<_>,_>>()?;
> let mut body = Vec::with_capacity(size as usize);
> for chunk in chunks { body.extend_from_slice(&chunk); }
> ```
> - delete file_upload after insert (cascade chunks) but FK ON DELETE CASCADE enabled; yes.

const nodeId = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003";
const artifactId = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004";

async function setup(t, intercept = async () => {}) {
  let disk = {
    canvas: {
      id: canvasId,

      revision: 1,
      viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 },

    await intercept(method, params);

    if (method === "conversation.list") return { turns: [], nextBefore: 0 };
    if (method === "workspace.delete") {
      workspaceList = workspaceList.filter(
        (workspace) => workspace.id !== params.workspaceId,
      );
      return { workspaces: structuredClone(workspaceList) };
    }
    if (method === "canvas.delete") {
      canvasList = canvasList.filter((canvas) => canvas.id !== params.canvasId);
      return { canvases: structuredClone(canvasList) };

        width: params.width,

  const close = async () => {
    try {
      socket.close();
    } catch {}
    try {
      child.kill("SIGKILL");
    } catch {}
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null)
        return resolve();
      const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 5000);
      child.once("exit", () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve();
      });
    });
    try {
      rmSync(profile, { recursive: true, force: true });
    } catch {}
  };

  return { send, sessionId, close };
}

/**
 * A target that is not the active one reports hit-testing at the document root
 * and silently drops dispatched input, so re-activate it before interacting.
 */
async function focusPage(page) {
  await page.send("Page.bringToFront", {}, page.sessionId);
  // Activation only takes effect once Chrome commits a frame, and a screenshot
  // forces that commit, after which hit-testing and input dispatch work again.
  await page.send(
    "Page.captureScreenshot",
    { format: "jpeg", quality: 20, captureBeyondViewport: false },
    page.sessionId,
  );
}

/** Evaluate an expression in the page and return its JSON value. */
export async function evaluate(page, expression) {
  const response = await page.send(
    "Runtime.evaluate",
    { expression, returnByValue: true, awaitPromise: true },
    page.sessionId,
  );
  if (response.exceptionDetails)
    throw new Error(
      response.exceptionDetails.exception?.description ??
        `evaluate failed: ${expression}`,
    );
  return response.result.value;
}

/** Poll until the expression is truthy; throws with a label when it never is. */
export async function waitFor(page, expression, label, timeout = 20_000) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeout;
  for (;;) {
    let value = false;
    try {
      value = await evaluate(page, expression);
    } catch {
      // The page may still be navigating; keep polling.
    }
    if (value) return value;
    if (Date.now() > deadline)
      throw new Error(`Timed out waiting for ${label}`);
    await sleep(120);
  }
}

/** Center and size of the first element matching a selector, or null. */
export async function boxOf(page, selector) {
  return evaluate(
    page,
    `(() => {
      const el = document.querySelector(${JSON.stringify(selector)});
      if (!el) return null;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return { x: r.left + r.width / 2, y: r.top + r.height / 2, width: r.width, height: r.height };
    })()`,
  );
}

/** Center of the element whose text contains `text`, or null. */
export async function boxByText(page, selector, text) {
  return evaluate(
    page,
    `(() => {
      const el = [...document.querySelectorAll(${JSON.stringify(selector)})]
        .find((node) => node.textContent.includes(${JSON.stringify(text)}));
      if (!el) return null;
      const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return { x: r.left + r.width / 2, y: r.top + r.height / 2, width: r.width, height: r.height };
    })()`,
  );
}

/** How many elements currently match a selector. */
export async function countOf(page, selector) {
  return evaluate(
    page,
    `document.querySelectorAll(${JSON.stringify(selector)}).length`,
  );
}

async function mouse(
  page,
  type,
  { x, y, button = "none", buttons = 0, clickCount = 0 },
) {
  await page.send(
    "Input.dispatchMouseEvent",
    { type, x, y, button, buttons, clickCount },
    page.sessionId,
  );
}

export async function clickAt(page, { x, y }) {
  await focusPage(page);
  await mouse(page, "mouseMoved", { x, y });
  await mouse(page, "mousePressed", {
    x,
    y,
    button: "left",
    buttons: 1,
    clickCount: 1,
  });
  await mouse(page, "mouseReleased", {
    x,
    y,
    button: "left",
    buttons: 0,
    clickCount: 1,
  });
}

/** Press on one point, move in steps, release on another — a real user drag. */

test("an applied HTML design renders in an inert frame on the canvas", async () => {
  const backend = await startBackend();
  key = backend.connectionKey;
  let browser;
  const rpc = async (method, params) => {
    const reply = await send(port, {
      body: JSON.stringify({
        protocolVersion: 1,
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        method,
        params,
      }),
    });
    assert.equal(reply.status, 200);
    const response = RuntimeResponseSchema.parse(JSON.parse(reply.text));
    assert.equal(response.error, undefined, JSON.stringify(response));
    return ResultSchemas[method].parse(response.result);
  };
  try {
    const workspace = await rpc("workspace.create", { name: "Design UI" });
    const workspaceId = workspace.workspace.id;
    const { canvas } = await rpc("canvas.create", {
      workspaceId,
      title: "Login design",
    });
    const reference = { workspaceId, canvasId: canvas.id };
    const turnId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const start = await rpc("conversation.start", {
      ...reference,
      turnId,
      prompt: "Design a login page",
      model: "test",
      anchor: { x: 0, y: 0 },
      nodeIds: [],
    });
    const source = `<!doctype html><style>body{background:#101828;color:#f8fafc;font-family:system-ui;display:grid;place-items:center;height:100vh;margin:0}main{width:320px}input,button{width:100%;padding:10px;margin:6px 0}</style><main><h1>Sign in</h1><input type="email" placeholder="you@example.com"><input type="password" placeholder="Password"><button>Continue</button></main><script>parent.document.title='owned';document.title='owned'</script>`;
    const finished = await rpc("conversation.finish", {
      ...reference,
      turnId,
      reply: "Here is a login page design.",
      operations: [
        {
          op: "createHtml",
          nodeId: crypto.randomUUID(),
          artifactId: crypto.randomUUID(),
          x: 400,
          y: 0,
          width: 960,
          height: 640,
          html: source,
        },
      ],
      status: "complete",
      error: "",
    });
    assert.equal(finished.turn.status, "pending");
    assert.equal(
      (
        await rpc("conversation.resolve", {
          ...reference,
          turnId,
          action: "apply",
        })
      ).turn.status,
      "applied",
    );
    assert.equal(start.context.nodes.length, 0);

    browser = await launchBrowser();
    await browser.send(
      "Page.navigate",
      { url: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}/` },
      browser.sessionId,
    );
    await waitFor(
      browser,
      `!!document.querySelector('#connection-key')`,
      "the connection form",
    );
    await evaluate(
      browser,
      `(() => { const input = document.querySelector('#connection-key'); input.value = ${JSON.stringify(key)}; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()`,
    );
    await clickAt(
      browser,
      await boxOf(browser, ".connbar button[type='submit']"),
    );
    await waitFor(
      browser,
      `!!document.querySelector('.connbar--ok')`,
      "the connected status",
    );
    const selectCard = async (label) => {
      const card = `[...document.querySelectorAll('.cards .card')].find((item) => item.textContent.includes(${JSON.stringify(label)}))`;
      await waitFor(
        browser,
        `${card} && !(${card}).disabled`,
        `the ${label} card`,
      );
      // Later tests add workspaces: scroll the target card into the list view
      // so its measured center is inside the clickable area.
      await evaluate(
        browser,
        `(${card}).focus(); (${card}).scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' })`,
      );
      await clickAt(browser, await boxByText(browser, ".cards .card", label));
    };
    for (const label of ["Design UI", "Login design"]) await selectCard(label);
    await waitFor(
      browser,
      `!!document.querySelector('.design iframe')`,
      "the design preview",
    );
    const frame = await evaluate(
      browser,
      `(() => {
        const iframe = document.querySelector('.design iframe');
        const box = iframe.getBoundingClientRect();
        return {
          sandbox: iframe.getAttribute('sandbox'),
          source: iframe.getAttribute('srcdoc'),
          width: box.width,
          height: box.height,
        };
      })()`,
    );
    assert.equal(frame.sandbox, "allow-same-origin", "scripts stay disabled");
    assert.match(frame.source, /Sign in/);
    assert.ok(frame.width > 0 && frame.height > 0, JSON.stringify(frame));
    await waitFor(
      browser,
      `document.querySelector('.design iframe').contentDocument?.body?.innerText.includes('Sign in')`,
      "the rendered login design",
    );
    assert.equal(
      await evaluate(
        browser,
        `getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.design iframe').contentDocument.body).backgroundColor`,
      ),
      "rgb(16, 24, 40)",
      "the design's own CSS applies",
    );
    assert.notEqual(
      await evaluate(browser, "document.title"),
      "owned",
      "design scripts never run",
    );
    // The design survives a reopen and is not stored as prose.
    await clickAt(
      browser,
      await boxOf(browser, '[aria-label="Canvas gallery"]'),
    );
    await selectCard("Login design");
    await waitFor(
      browser,
      `!!document.querySelector('.design iframe')`,
      "the reopened design",
    );
    const stored = await rpc("canvas.open", reference);
    const design = stored.artifacts.find(
      (artifact) => artifact.type === "html",
    );
    assert.equal(design.html, source);
    assert.equal(
      stored.artifacts.some(
        (artifact) =>
          artifact.type === "text" && artifact.text.includes("Sign in"),
      ),
      false,
      "the design is not duplicated as a text card",
    );
  } catch (error) {
    if (browser)
      error.message += `\nRendered state: ${await evaluate(browser, "JSON.stringify({text:document.body.innerText.slice(-2000),frames:document.querySelectorAll('iframe').length})")}`;
    throw error;
  } finally {
    await browser?.close();
    await stopBackend(backend.child);
  }
});

  import { LIMITS } from "@agentica/protocol";

    onOpen: (id: string) => void;
    onDelete: (id: string) => void;
    onBack: () => void;
    onOpenSettings: () => void;
  }

  let {
    workspaceName,
    canvases,
    connection,
    busy,
    error,
    onCreate,
    onOpen,
    onDelete,
    onBack,
    onOpenSettings,
  }: Props = $props();

  let title = $state("");
  // Deleting storage is destructive, so the row asks for confirmation first.

</script>

{#snippet actions()}

<Modal
  wide

>

  <div class="split">
    <section class="panel">

      </header>
      <p class="panel__hint">
        An infinite canvas of text nodes. You can add and arrange them freely.
      </p>
      <form
        class="stack"
        onsubmit={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          onCreate(title.trim());
        }}
      >
        <label class="sr-only" for="canvas-title">Canvas title</label>
        <input
          id="canvas-title"
          bind:value={title}
          required
          maxlength={LIMITS.label}
          placeholder="e.g. Launch plan"

          class="btn btn--primary btn--block"

              size={18}
            />{/if}
          Create &amp; open
        </button>
      </form>
    </section>

    <section class="panel panel--list">

        <span class="panel__badge"><Icon name="layers" size={18} /></span>
        <h2>Saved canvases</h2>
        <span class="count">{canvases.length}</span>
      </header>

      {#if canvases.length === 0}
        <div class="empty">
          <Icon name="map" size={30} />
          <p>No saved canvases yet</p>
          <small>Create one on the left and it will appear here.</small>
        </div>

                  >
                    <Icon name="delete_forever" size={18} />
                    Delete

                  <button
                    class="btn btn--ghost"
                    type="button"
                    onclick={() => (confirming = "")}
                  >

                  </button>

                </div>

            </li>
          {/each}

  </footer>
</Modal>
